PhD Position in Soft Robotics Systems 100%, Zürich, befristet Druck Druckerzeugnisse Das Soft Robotics Lab des Instituts für Robotik und Intelligente Systeme der ETH Zürich lädt zur Bewerbung um eine offene Doktorandenstelle ein. Wir suchen einen außergewöhnlichen, praktischen Ingenieur, der die nächste Generation künstlicher Muskel-Skelett-Roboter entwerfen, bauen und zum Leben erwecken kann. Ziel unseres Labors ist es, Roboter grundlegend anders zu bauen, zu modellieren und zu steuern, so dass sie flexibler, geschickter, fähiger werden und sich besser an ihre Umgebung anpassen. Das Labor hat seine Forschung im Bereich Roboterdesign und Algorithmen durch reale Anwendungen wie einen Roboterfisch für die Unterwasserbewegung, weiche Roboterhände für Pick-and-Place-Aufgaben und Multisegmentarme für die dynamische Objektmanipulation vorgestellt. Projekthintergrund Heutige Roboter sind meist starr, zerbrechlich und eine Welt abseits der Agilität und Widerstandsfähigkeit biologischer Körper. Wir glauben, dass der Weg zu fähigen, sicheren und lebensechten Maschinen durch muskuloskelettale weiche Roboter verläuft: Systeme, die aus nachgiebigen Strukturen, Knochen, Gelenken und sehnenähnlicher Betätigung aufgebaut sind, ähnlich wie die Körper von Tieren und Menschen. Als PhD-Forscher in unserer Gruppe leiten Sie das Design, die Herstellung und das reale Testen dieser Roboter Ende an Ende und verwandeln Ideen in funktionierende Hardware, die sich bewegt, erfasst und mit der physischen Welt interagiert. Dies ist die Rolle eines Erbauers in seinem Kern. Sie werden über mechanisches Design, weiche und konforme Betätigung, Fertigung, Elektronik und Steuerung arbeiten, um vollständige Robotersysteme zu erstellen, und dann unerbittlich durch praktische Experimente iterieren, bis sie in der realen Welt funktionieren. Unsere jüngsten Arbeiten, von einer biohybriden Knochen-Muskel-Schnittstelle, die Robotern echte Muskeln und Sehnen zu einem Roboterfisch, geschickten weichen Händen und dynamischen Manipulatorarmen gibt, spiegeln die Art von ehrgeiziger, physischer Forschung wider, der Sie beitreten würden. Stellenbeschreibung
• Sie werden muskuloskelettale weiche Roboter vom Konzept zum funktionierenden Prototyp bringen: Konzeption der Architektur, Entwurf und Herstellung der Struktur- und Betätigungselemente, Integration von Sensorik und Steuerung und Validierung der Leistung durch systematische reale Tests Jeder Entwurfszyklus füttert den nächsten, so dass Rapid Prototyping, Messung und Iteration im Mittelpunkt des Projekts stehen.
• Indem Sie sich von biologischen Muskel-Skelett-Systemen inspirieren lassen, entwickeln Sie, wie Knochen, Gelenke, Sehnen und Muskeln mit nachgiebigen Materialien und Aktoren nachgebildet werden können und wie ihr Zusammenspiel Kraft, Geschicklichkeit und Robustheit erzeugt Ziel ist es, Roboter zu bauen, die einen Großteil ihrer Fähigkeiten aus ihrer Verkörperung ableiten und ein reiches, adaptives Verhalten mit weniger Abhängigkeit von komplexer zentralisierter Steuerung erreichen.
• Sie kombinieren praktisches mechanisches Design, Fertigung und experimentelle Tests mit Modellierung, Betätigung und Steuerung, um vollständige, funktionale Roboter zu liefern, die von einzelnen betätigten Gelenken bis hin zu integrierten Multisegment-Gliedern und vollständigen Muskel-Skelett-Körpern reichen Eine enge, tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit dem maschinellen Lernteam des Labors und seinem Muskelteam ist erforderlich und der Schlüssel zum Projekt: Sie integrieren lernbasierte Steuerung und Sensorik mit der biologischen und künstlichen Muskeltechnologie des Teams, um Roboter zu bauen, die keine einzelne Disziplin alleine erreichen könnte Profil Sie sind extrem neugierig, hoch motiviert, sehr unabhängig und möchten mit Ihrer Forschung einen echten Unterschied machen. Sie arbeiten am besten, wenn Sie in einem Team sind, Sie sind respektvoll und gedeihen, wenn Sie mit anderen zusammenarbeiten und Unterstützung bieten können. Durch Ihre bisherigen Erfahrungen haben Sie im Idealfall bereits Ihr Verständnis und Ihre Fähigkeiten gezeigt in: Master-Abschluss in Maschinenbau, Robotik, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik oder einem eng verwandten Bereich
• Demonstrierte praktische Erfahrung beim Bau physischer Systeme: Prototyping, CAD, Fertigung (z. B. 3D-Druck, Bearbeitung, Formgebung), Elektronik oder Roboterintegration

Doctorat en Systèmes de Robotique Douce 100%, Zurich, durée déterminée imprimer Drucken Le Soft Robotics Lab de l'Institut de Robotique et de Systèmes Intelligents de Zurich invite les candidats à un poste de doctorat ouvert. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur exceptionnel et pratique pour concevoir, construire et donner vie à la prochaine génération de robots musculosquelettiques artificiels. Le but de notre laboratoire est de construire, de modéliser et de contrôler des robots d'une manière fondamentalement différente, afin qu'ils deviennent plus flexibles, dextérieux, capables et s'adaptent mieux à leur environnement. Le laboratoire a présenté ses recherches en conception robotique et en algorithmes à travers des applications du monde réel telles qu'un poisson robotisé pour la locomotion sous-marine, des mains robotiques douces pour les tâches de pick-and-place, et des bras multi-segments pour la manipulation dynamique d'objets. Contexte du projet Aujourd'hui, les robots sont pour la plupart rigides, fragiles et un monde à part l'agilité et la résilience des corps biologiques. Nous croyons que le chemin vers des machines capables, sûres et qui ressemblent à une vie passe par des robots mous musculosquelettiques : des systèmes construits à partir de structures, d'os, de articulations et d'actionnements semblables à des tendons, tout comme les corps des animaux et des humains. En tant que doctorant au sein de notre groupe, vous dirigerez la conception, la fabrication et les essais sur le monde réel de ces robots se terminent par la transformation des idées en matériel de travail qui bouge, saisit et interagit avec le monde physique. Il s'agit d'un rôle de constructeur à son cœur. Vous travaillerez à travers la conception mécanique, l'actionnement souple et conforme, la fabrication, l'électronique et le contrôle pour créer des systèmes robotiques complets, puis itérer sans relâche par l'expérimentation pratique jusqu'à ce qu'ils se produisent dans le monde réel. Notre travail récent, à partir d'une interface osseux-muscle biohybride qui donne aux robots de véritables muscles et tendons à un poisson robotisé, des mains douces dextérieuses et des bras manipulateurs dynamiques, reflète le genre de recherche physique ambitieuse que vous joindrez. Description du poste
• Vous prendrez des robots mous musculosquelettiques du concept au prototype de travail: concevoir l'architecture, concevoir et fabriquer les éléments structuraux et d'action, intégrer la détection et le contrôle, et valider les performances par des tests systématiques du monde réel
• Chaque cycle de conception alimente le prochain, si rapide prototypage, mesure et itération sont au cœur du projet
• S'inspirant des systèmes musculo-squelettiques biologiques, vous concevrez comment les os, les articulations, les tendons et les muscles peuvent être recréés avec des matériaux et des actionneurs conformes, et comment leur interaction produit force, dextérité et robustesse
• L'objectif est de construire des robots qui tirent une grande partie de leurs capacités de leur incarnation, en réalisant un comportement riche et adaptatif avec moins de dépendance à un contrôle centralisé complexe
• Vous combinerez la conception mécanique manuelle, la fabrication et les essais expérimentaux avec la modélisation, l'actionnement et le contrôle pour fournir des robots complets et fonctionnels, allant des articulations actionnées simples aux membres intégrés à plusieurs segments et aux corps musculosquelettiques complets
• Une étroite collaboration quotidienne avec l'équipe d'apprentissage automatique du labo et son équipe musculaire sera nécessaire et est la clé du projet : vous intégrerez le contrôle et la détection basés sur l'apprentissage à la technologie biologique et musculaire artificielle de l'équipe pour construire des robots qu'aucune discipline ne pourrait atteindre seule Profil Vous êtes extrêmement curieux, très motivé, très indépendant, et vous voulez faire une vraie différence avec votre recherche. Vous travaillez mieux quand vous êtes dans une équipe, vous êtes respectueux et prospère quand vous pouvez collaborer avec d'autres et fournir du soutien. Grâce à vos expériences antérieures, vous avez idéalement déjà démontré votre compréhension et vos compétences dans:
• Maîtrise en génie mécanique, robotique, mécatronique, génie électrique ou domaine étroitement lié
• Expérience pratique démontrée de construction de systèmes physiques : prototypage, CAO, fabrication (par exemple impression 3D, usinage, moulage), électronique ou intégration robot

Mitarbeiter:in Forschungsethik (m/w/d)

40%-60%, Zürich, befristet

print
Drucken

Die Ethikkommission der ETH Zürich begutachtet und bewilligt insbesondere Forschungsvorhaben mit Menschen und Personendaten , die nicht in die Zuständigkeit einer kantonalen Ethikkommission fallen. Damit trägt sie zur Förderung ethisch vertretbarer Forschung und zur Stärkung des ethischen Verantwortungsbewusstseins der Forschenden bei. Die in der Fachstelle Humanforschung und Forschungsethik angesiedelte Geschäftsstelle unterstützt die Kommission bei der Wahrnehmung ihrer Aufgabe in fachlicher und administrativer Hinsicht.

Für eine befristete Vertretung in der Geschäftsstelle suchen wir per 1. Januar 2027 eine initiative und zuverlässige Persönlichkeit. Die Stelle ist bis Ende Dezember 2027 befristet.

Stellenbeschreibung

Nach der Einarbeitung nehmen Sie insbesondere folgende Aufgaben zunehmend eigenständig wahr:

• die Prüfung der Ethikanträge auf ihre formale und inhaltliche Vollständigkeit

• die Vorbereitung der Beschlüsse auf der Basis der eingegangenen Beurteilungen

• die Korrespondenz mit den antragsstellenden Personen

• die Beratung der Forschenden, insbesondere bezüglich der Zuständigkeit der Kommission, des Beurteilungsverfahrens und der Umsetzung von Auflagen, um Vorbehalte auszuräumen

• Unterstützung des Präsidiums und Austausch mit anderen ETH-internen Stellen

• die Publikation der für die Forschenden relevanten Informationen auf dem Web

Profil

• Hochschulstudium (mindestens Bachelorabschluss), bevorzugt in Philosophie, Sozial- oder Naturwissenschaften

descriptionByLocale.it:
PhD posizione in Biohybrid Robotics 100%, Zurigo, contratto a tempo determinato stampa Druppo Descrizione Costruire la generazione prossima di robot attuati da pazienti in un laboratorio il cui lavoro bioibrido recente è stato pubblicato in Science Advances e Advanced Intelligent Systems. Il Laboratorio di Robotica Soft all'interno dell'Istituto di Robotica e Sistemi Intelligenti dell'ETH Zurigo invita le candidature per una posizione aperta di dottorato. Cerchiamo un eccellente ricercatore per unirsi e avanzare i nostri sforzi di ricerca nella produzione e controllo di robot bioibridi. L'obiettivo del nostro laboratorio è costruire, modellare e controllare i robot in un modo oscuro, in modo che diventanono più flessibili, agili, capaci e adattabili all'ambiente. Dal lato bioibrido, il laboratorio ha recentemente dimostrato muscolo-tendine 3D-bioprintate con trasmissione di forza migliorata (Science Advances, 2025) e pazienti sensorizzati che permettono il controllo proprioceutivo a chiusura (Advanced Intelligent Systems, 2025), lavoro che è stato presentato nella stampa ETH e nei media internazionali di robotica. Contesto del progetto La frontiera della ricerca in robotica soft mira a sostituire i classici materiali morbo utilizzati per gli attuatori con quelli biologici (muscoli) per sfruttare l'adattabilità innata, l'efficienza energetica e la morbidezza dei sistemi biologici. Quando pochi anni fa robot bioibridi (bio-bots) potrebbero essere considerati una questione di fantascienza, il lavoro recente ha mostrato bio-bots che nuotano come pesci, camminano come formiche e persino macchine biologiche per la raccolta e il posizionamento potenziate da tessuti ingegnerizzati. All'interno di questa area di ricerca, lo pianificazione SRL, fabbrica e caratterizza robot bioibridi attuati da motori. I costrutti vengono prodotti utilizzando la stampa a gel di idrogel, la micro-molding e la bioprinting a luce e extrusione, poi attuati attraverso la stimolazione elettrica e analizzati tramite la tracciatura del movimento. Le attuali sfide di ricerca includono la scalabilità dei tessuti ingegnerizzati, il controllo della formazione dei miofibri durante la biofabbricazione e la maturazione, l'esplorazione delle architetture tessutali da biomimetico a biosintetico, l'integrazione della propriocezione negli attuatori basati su rischi e la scoperta di materiali sostenibili per i sistemi bioibridi (compresi fonti non mammiliane). I risultati recenti del laboratorio comprendono la bioprinting muscolo-tendine per attuatori muscolo-scheletrici bioibridi ottimizzati meccanicamente con trasmissione di forza migliorata (Filippi et sui., Science Advances, 2025); pazienti sensorizzati per il controllo proprioceuridi a chiusura dei robot bioibridi (Filippi efabbricat al., Advanced Intelligent Systems, 2025); tessuti correlati scheletrico bioprintcafluppi a scala Requisiti Il candidato dovrà un team interdisciplinare che lavora all'intersezione dell'ingegneria tessutale, della biofabbricazione, della robotica e del controllo. La guida viene fornita da ricerca senior bioibridi nel laboratorio, compresi Miriam Filippi e Aiste Balciunaite, entrambi coautori dei lavori citati sopra. Le collaborazioni incrociate all'interno dell'ETH Zurigo e le collaborazioni internazionali attive con IBEC Barcelona (Sanchez, Guix), l'Università di Tokyo (Takeuchi) e Empa (Clemens) fanno parte dell'ambiente di ricerca quotidiano. Cosa? I candidati devono essere impiegati secondo le norme dell'ETH Zurigo, e dopo aver completato il dottorato, saranno insigniti del titolo di "Dottore delle Scienze (Dr. sc. ETH Zurigo)". Ulteriori informazioni sulla dottorato dell'ETH Zurigo possono essere trovate qui . Contatto La tesi lavorerà su:
• progettazione e ingegneria di bioreattori per la meccanica ten, la stimolazione elettrica e la maturazione a lungo termine dei costrutti ingegnerizzati
• Bioprinting di architetture complesse utilizzando l'extrusione e la bioprinting a luce
• Controllo elettro-muscolare dei robot bioibridi
• Sviluppo di materiali sostenibili per i sistemi bioibridi
• Altre attività correlate alla ricerca del laboratorio
descriptionByLocale.en:
PhD position in Biohybrid Robotics

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

Build the next generation of muscle-actuated robots in a lab whose recent biohybrid work has been published in Science Advances and Advanced Intelligent Systems.

The Soft Robotics Lab within the Institute of Robotics and Intelligent Systems at ETH Zurich is inviting applications for an open doctoral position. We are looking for an excellent researcher to join and advance our research efforts in the fabrication and control of biohybrid robots. Our lab's goal is to build, model, and control robots in a fundamentally different way, so that they become more flexible, dexterous, capable, and adapt better to their environment. On the biohybrid side, the lab has recently demonstrated 3D-bioprinted muscle-tendon interfaces with enhanced force transmission (Science Advances, 2025) and sensor-embedded muscle enabling closed-loop proprioceptive control (Advanced Intelligent Systems, 2025), work that has been featured in ETH press and international robotics media.

Project background

The frontier of research in soft robotics aims at replacing classic soft materials used for actuators with biological ones (muscle) to take advantage of the innate adaptability, energy efficiency, and softness of biological systems. While a few years ago these biohybrid robots (bio-bots) could be considered a matter for science fiction, recent work has demonstrated fish-like swimming bio-bots, caterpillar-like walking bio-bots, and even pick-and-place biological machines powered by engineered muscle tissue.

Within this research area, the SRL designs, fabricates, and characterizes muscle-driven biohybrid robots. Muscle constructs are produced using hydrogel casting, micro-molding, and light- and extrusion-based bioprinting, then actuated through electrical stimulation and analyzed via motion tracking. Current research challenges include scaling up engineered muscle tissues, controlling myofiber formation during biofabrication and maturation, exploring tissue architectures from biomimetic to biosynthetic forms, integrating proprioception into muscle-based actuators, and discovering sustainable materials for biohybrid systems (including non-mammalian sources).

Recent results from the lab include muscle–tendon bioprinting of mechanically optimized musculoskeletal bioactuators with enhanced force transmission (Filippi et al., Science Advances, 2025); sensor-embedded muscle for closed-loop, proprioceptive control of biohybrid robots (Filippi et al., Advanced Intelligent Systems, 2025); perfusable bioprinted skeletal muscle tissue at the centimeter scale (Filippi et al., Advanced Healthcare Materials, 2023); a perspective on microfluidics for functionally integrated biohybrid robots (Filippi et al., PNAS, 2022); and bilayered biofabrication unlocking skeletal muscle for biohybrid soft robots (Balciunaite et al., RoboSoft, 2024).

The doctoral candidate will join an interdisciplinary team working at the intersection of tissue engineering, biofabrication, robotics, and control. Day-to-day mentorship will come from senior biohybrid researchers in the lab, including Miriam Filippi and Aiste Balciunaite, both co-authors on the works cited above. Cross-group collaborations within ETH Zurich and active international collaborations with IBEC Barcelona (Sanchez, Guix), the University of Tokyo (Takeuchi), and Empa (Clemens) are part of the day-to-day research environment.

Doctoral candidates will be employed according to the regulations of ETH Zurich, and upon completing the doctorate, will be awarded the title "Doctor of Sciences (Dr. sc. ETH Zurich)". More information about the ETH Zurich doctorate can be found here .

Job description

The thesis work will focus on:

• Designing and engineering bioreactors for the mechanical tensioning, electrical stimulation, and long-term maturation of engineered muscle constructs

• Bioprinting of complex muscle architectures using extrusion- and ligh

Drucken

Die Militärakademie (MILAK) an der ETH Zürich ist das Kompetenzzentrum für Militärwissenschaften und die Aus- und Weiterbildungsstätte für Berufsoffiziere. Forschungsschwerpunkte der Dozentur Militärsoziologie sind die Auseinandersetzung mit dem Schweizer Milizsystem, die internationale Streitkräfteentwicklung und die zivil-militärischen Beziehungen

Projekthintergrund

In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Center for Security Studies (CSS) der ETH Zürich wird jährlich die Studie «Sicherheit» durchgeführt und erhebt die aussen-, sicherheits- und verteidigungspolitische Meinungsbildung der Schweizer Stimmbevölkerung.

Stellenbeschreibung

Als Mitautor:in der Studie «Sicherheit 2027» unterstützen Sie die Dozentur Militärsoziologie beim Publikationsprozess (Datenerhebung, Datenauswertung, Verfassen von Kapiteln und Zusammenfassungen, Medienarbeit). Neben der Mitarbeit an diesem Forschungsprojekt werden kleinere Arbeiten für die Dozentur anfallen.

Profil

Sie sind Sozialwissenschaftler:in (vorzugsweise mit Abschluss in Soziologie oder Politikwissenschaften), verfügen über gute Kenntnisse der quantitativen empirischen Sozialforschung und bringen Interesse an Meinungsumfragen, Sicherheitspolitik und Militärsoziologie mit. Sie sind versiert in der statistischen Datenauswertung mit R und im Umgang mit den gängigen Office-Programmen und haben ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Französisch sind von Vorteil. Die Stelle ist als Förderung für junge Akademiker/innen gedacht. Deshalb dürfen Ihr Studienabschluss und der Arbeitsbeginn höchstens 18 Monate auseinanderliegen.

Arbeitsort

Wir bieten

Die Dozentur Militärsoziologie besteht aus einem jungen Team, das eine rege, internationale Forschungstätigkeit aufweist. Ihr Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in Birmensdorf ZH, Kaserne Reppischtal.

Posizione di dottorato in AI for Materials Modeling 100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato stampa Drucken Il Materials Modeling Group, fondato nel febbraio 2026 e guidato dal Prof. Malik Wagih nel Dipartimento dei materiali dell'ETH di Zurigo, invita a presentare domande per una posizione di dottorato all'intersezione tra intelligenza artificiale, simulazione atomistica e scienza dei materiali, a partire da settembre 2026 o di comune accordo. Il nostro gruppo sviluppa metodi computazionali per accelerare la scoperta e la progettazione di leghe strutturali attraverso l'ingegneria dei difetti, con particolare attenzione ai materiali per ambienti estremi, compresa l'energia di fusione e le applicazioni spaziali. La nostra ricerca combina teoria, simulazione basata sulla fisica e apprendimento automatico. Descrizione del lavoro
• Il progetto di dottorato svilupperà metodi di apprendimento automatico per la modellazione di materiali atomistici.
• Le possibili direzioni di ricerca includono potenziali interatomici appresi dalla macchina, apprendimento automatico basato sulla fisica e modelli generativi. La domanda di ricerca specifica sarà definita insieme al candidato prescelto. Il candidato prescelto entrerà a far parte come uno dei primi studenti di dottorato del gruppo e avrà l'opportunità di contribuire a plasmare la sua cultura della ricerca e la direzione scientifica. Profilo
• Un master, o completamento previsto prima dell'inizio della posizione, in scienza dei materiali, fisica, ingegneria, informatica, matematica applicata o un campo correlato
• Competenza nella programmazione e nel calcolo scientifico
• Forte interesse per lo sviluppo o l'applicazione di metodi di intelligenza artificiale a problemi nelle scienze fisiche
• Esperienza precedente o corsi di apprendimento automatico, teoria del funzionale della densità o dinamica molecolare sono vantaggiosi
• Capacità di comunicazione efficaci sul posto di lavoro in inglese Offriamo
• Posizione interamente finanziata con stipendio competitivo secondo gli standard ETH
• Accesso a infrastrutture computazionali all'avanguardia

Promuoviamo le pari opportunità, valorizziamo la diversità e coltiviamo un ambiente di lavoro e di apprendimento in cui i diritti e la dignità di tutto il nostro personale e degli studenti sono rispettati. Visita il nostro sito web Pari opportunità e diversità per scoprire come garantiamo un ambiente giusto e aperto che consenta a tutti di crescere e prosperare. Per noi la sostenibilità è un valore fondamentale: lavoriamo costantemente per un futuro a impatto climatico zero. Curioso? Anche noi lo siamo. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online con i seguenti documenti (in formato PDF) entro il 15 luglio 2026:
• Curriculum vitae
• Informazioni di contatto per almeno due revisori

Tieni presente che accettiamo esclusivamente candidature inviate tramite il nostro portale di candidatura online. Non verranno prese in considerazione candidature inviate tramite posta elettronica o servizi postali. Per ulteriori informazioni sulla posizione, contattare il Prof. Malik Wagih all'indirizzo malik.wagih@mat.ethz.ch (nessuna candidatura). Le candidature verranno esaminate su base continuativa fino alla copertura della posizione. Informazioni sull'ETH di Zurigo L'ETH di Zurigo è una delle università leader a livello mondiale specializzata in scienza e tecnologia. Siamo rinomati per la nostra eccellente formazione, la ricerca fondamentale all'avanguardia e il trasferimento diretto di nuove conoscenze nella società. Oltre 30.000 persone provenienti da più di 120 paesi trovano la nostra università un luogo che promuove il pensiero indipendente e un ambiente che ispira l'eccellenza. Situati nel cuore dell’Europa, ma creando collegamenti in tutto il mondo, lavoriamo insieme per sviluppare soluzioni per le sfide globali di oggi e di domani.
descriptionByLocale.en:
PhD Position in AI for Materials Modeling

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

The Materials Modeling Group , established in February 2026 and led by Prof. Malik Wagih in the Department of Materials at ETH Zurich, invites applications for a PhD position at the intersection of artificial intelligence, atomistic simulation, and materials science, starting in September 2026 or by mutual agreement.

Our group develops computational methods to accelerate the discovery and design of structural alloys through defect engineering, with a particular focus on materials for extreme environments, including fusion energy and space applications. Our research combines theory, physics-based simulation, and machine learning.

Job description

• The PhD project will develop machine-learning methods for atomistic materials modeling

• Possible research directions include machine-learned interatomic potentials, physics-informed machine learning, and generative models. The specific research question will be shaped jointly with the successful candidate

The successful candidate will join as one of the group’s first doctoral students and will have the opportunity to help shape its research culture and scientific direction.

Profile

• A Master's degree, or expected completion before the position begins, in materials science, physics, engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related field

• Proficiency in programming and scientific computing

• Strong interest in developing or applying artificial intelligence methods to problems in the physical sciences

• Prior experience or coursework in machine learning, density functional theory, or molecular dynamics is advantageous

• Effective communication skills in English

Workplace

We offer

Assistente di ricerca in tecnologie sanitarie digitali 80%-100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato stampa Drucken Il laboratorio di scienza dei dati biomedici (BMDS) studia soluzioni basate sui dati per applicazioni sanitarie con particolare attenzione a condizioni neurologiche come lesioni del midollo spinale (SCI), lombalgia, disturbi neurodegenerativi e tumori neurologici. Al centro della nostra ricerca c’è la collaborazione tra discipline che spaziano dalla medicina, alla biologia, all’informatica e alla scienza dei dati. Stiamo cercando un assistente di ricerca che si unisca a questo team in crescita e contribuisca agli studi di ricerca attuali. La data di inizio prevista è il 1° agosto 2026. Contesto del progetto La lombalgia (LBP) è una delle principali cause di disabilità in tutto il mondo e il suo trattamento efficace è impegnativo. Le iniezioni di steroidi lombari sono una terapia comune per il LBP, indipendentemente dalla causa sottostante. Tuttavia, la sua efficacia mostra un’elevata variabilità tra i pazienti. È necessario un approccio più personalizzato al trattamento del LBP con la terapia iniettiva. Gli approcci personalizzati richiedono una comprensione completa dello stato di salute del paziente al di là delle informazioni statiche derivanti dalla consultazione clinica. Negli ultimi anni, la salute mobile e le tecnologie indossabili hanno presentato un quadro per valutare continuamente misure oggettive e soggettive nell’ambiente naturale del paziente. In questo progetto di ricerca, abbiamo deciso di sviluppare un'applicazione per smartphone centrata sul paziente per il monitoraggio remoto dei pazienti con LBP per prevedere il risultato del trattamento individuale dopo la terapia iniettiva. Stiamo attualmente conducendo uno studio di usabilità e fattibilità per testare l'applicazione in uno scenario reale e garantirne la funzionalità. Condurremo quindi uno studio osservazionale e raccoglieremo dati per prevedere l'esito del trattamento con iniezione utilizzando metodi di apprendimento automatico con l'obiettivo di includere questi modelli come strumento di previsione personalizzato nell'applicazione per smartphone. Research Assistant in Digital Health Technologies

80%-100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

The Biomedical Data Science (BMDS) Lab investigates data-driven solutions for healthcare applications with a focus on neurological conditions such as spinal cord injury (SCI), lower back pain, neuro-degenerative disorders and neurological tumors. At the core of our research is the collaboration across disciplines spanning expertise in medicine, biology, computer and data science. We are seeking a research assistant to join this growing team and contribute to current research studies. The anticipated start date is August 1, 2026.

Project background

Low back pain (LBP) is amongst the leading causes of disability worldwide and its effective treatment is challenging. Lumbar steroid injections are a common therapy for LBP, irrespective of the underlying cause. However, its effectiveness shows high variability across patients. There is a need for a more personalized approach to the treatment of LBP with injection therapy. Personalized approaches require a comprehensive understanding of the patient’s health status beyond static information from clinical consultation. In recent years, mobile health and wearable technologies have presented a framework to assess objective and subjective measures continuously in a patient’s natural environment. In this research project, we set out to develop a patient-centered smartphone application for remote patient monitoring of patients with LBP to predict their individual treatment outcome after injection therapy. We are currently conducting a usability and feasibility study to test the application in a real-world scenario and ensure its functionality. We will then conduct an observational study and collect data to predict injection treatment outcome using machine learning methods with the goal to include these models as a personalized prediction tool in the smartphone application.

Job description

• Data Collection: Conduct data acquisition for ongoing research studies on low back pain

• Data Management: Enter, organize, and clean datasets to ensure accuracy and high data quality

• Participant Recruitment: Support the project lead in recruiting and enrolling study participants

• Administrative Coordination: Schedule study appointments and assist with coordinating team activities and responsibilities

• Research Collaboration: Work closely with the PhD researcher to support all aspects of the project

Profile

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Neuroscience, Psychology, Health Sciences, or a related field

• You have prior experience working in research settings and are familiar with standard study procedures

• You are highly organized, dependable, and able to manage multiple tasks efficiently

• You are motivated to contribute to a collaborative and interdisciplinary research environment and are committed to scientific excellence

• You are fluent in German (written and spoken) and confident communicating in English

Workplace

We offer

We offer a 1-year project-based contract at the BMDS Lab ( 80% - 100% workload ).

• A stimulating, collaborative environment in a multidisciplinary team at ETH Zurich and Schulthess Klinik, combining academic and clinical perspectives

• Support ongoing studies on low back pain with direct relevance to patient care and clinical practice

• Gain hands-on experience in research processes, including data collection, data management, and study coordination

• Develop insights into how research is conducted in close collaboration with a leading specialized clinic

• Become part of a motivated, supportive, and collaborative team environment

• Learn from experienced researchers and clinicians while contributing to an active research project

Im Mittelpunkt unserer Forschung steht die interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Fachkenntnissen in Medizin, Biologie, Informatik und Datenwissenschaft. Wir suchen einen wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeiter, der sich diesem wachsenden Team anschließt und zu aktuellen Forschungsstudien beiträgt. Der voraussichtliche Starttermin ist der 1. August 2026. Hintergrund des Projekts Schmerzen im unteren Rücken (LBP) gehören zu den häufigsten Ursachen für Behinderungen weltweit und ihre wirksame Behandlung ist eine Herausforderung. Lumbale Steroidinjektionen sind eine gängige Therapie für LBP, unabhängig von der zugrunde liegenden Ursache. Die Wirksamkeit weist jedoch eine hohe Variabilität zwischen den Patienten auf. Es besteht Bedarf an einem individuelleren Ansatz für die Behandlung von LBP mittels Injektionstherapie. Personalisierte Ansätze erfordern ein umfassendes Verständnis des Gesundheitszustands des Patienten, das über statische Informationen aus der klinischen Beratung hinausgeht. In den letzten Jahren haben mobile Gesundheits- und Wearable-Technologien einen Rahmen für die kontinuierliche Bewertung objektiver und subjektiver Messungen in der natürlichen Umgebung eines Patienten geschaffen. In diesem Forschungsprojekt haben wir uns zum Ziel gesetzt, eine patientenzentrierte Smartphone-Anwendung zur Fernüberwachung von Patienten mit LBP zu entwickeln, um deren individuelles Behandlungsergebnis nach einer Injektionstherapie vorherzusagen. Wir führen derzeit eine Usability- und Machbarkeitsstudie durch, um die Anwendung in einem realen Szenario zu testen und ihre Funktionalität sicherzustellen. Anschließend werden wir eine Beobachtungsstudie durchführen und Daten sammeln, um mithilfe maschineller Lernmethoden das Ergebnis einer Injektionsbehandlung vorherzusagen, mit dem Ziel, diese Modelle als personalisiertes Vorhersagetool in die Smartphone-Anwendung einzubinden. Assistant de recherche en technologies de santé numérique 80 % - 100 %, Zurich, durée déterminée imprimer Drucken Le laboratoire Biomedical Data Science (BMDS) étudie des solutions basées sur les données pour les applications de soins de santé en mettant l'accent sur les affections neurologiques telles que les lésions médullaires (LME), les douleurs lombaires, les troubles neurodégénératifs et les tumeurs neurologiques. Au cœur de notre recherche se trouve la collaboration entre disciplines couvrant l’expertise en médecine, biologie, informatique et science des données. Nous recherchons un assistant de recherche pour rejoindre cette équipe en pleine croissance et contribuer aux études de recherche en cours. La date de début prévue est le 1er août 2026. Contexte du projet La lombalgie (LBP) est l'une des principales causes d'invalidité dans le monde et son traitement efficace est difficile. Les injections de stéroïdes lombaires sont un traitement courant contre la lombalgie, quelle que soit la cause sous-jacente. Cependant, son efficacité présente une grande variabilité selon les patients. Il existe un besoin pour une approche plus personnalisée du traitement de la lombalgie par thérapie par injection. Les approches personnalisées nécessitent une compréhension globale de l’état de santé du patient au-delà des informations statiques issues de la consultation clinique. Ces dernières années, la santé mobile et les technologies portables ont présenté un cadre permettant d’évaluer en continu des mesures objectives et subjectives dans l’environnement naturel d’un patient. Dans ce projet de recherche, nous avons entrepris de développer une application pour smartphone centrée sur le patient pour la surveillance à distance des patients atteints de lombalgie afin de prédire le résultat de leur traitement individuel après un traitement par injection. Nous menons actuellement une étude d'utilisabilité et de faisabilité pour tester l'application dans un scénario réel et garantir sa fonctionnalité. Nous mènerons ensuite une étude observationnelle et collecterons des données pour prédire le résultat du traitement par injection à l'aide de méthodes d'apprentissage automatique dans le but d'inclure ces modèles comme outil de prédiction personnalisé dans l'application pour smartphone. descriptionByLocale.en:
Doctoral position on PFAS Pathways: Tracking “Forever Chemicals” through Soil–Groundwater Interfaces for Safer Water

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

The Subsurface Environmental Processes Group (Eawag and ETH Zurich) is seeking a dynamic and motivated doctoral student to study the dynamics of PFAS in subsurface environments. Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are a class of highly persistent synthetic compounds increasingly detected in soils and aquifers worldwide. Their extreme stability and mobility make PFAS a critical challenge for groundwater quality and drinking water security. Although PFAS contamination has been reported in many regions, the fundamental mechanisms controlling PFAS fate and transport in coupled soil–aquifer systems remain poorly understood.

Job description

• The focus of this PhD project will be on quantifying the control exerted by soil physico-chemical properties and episodic recharge events on the fate, transport, and transformation of PFAS

• The student will have the unique opportunity to learn, develop, and apply a range of cutting-edge (laboratory) experimental and modeling techniques, including the integration of machine learning and process-based models

• Measurements will be guided by and compared with the modeling developed in this project

• Findings will help advance our knowledge of governing processes of PFAS mobility in soils and aquifers, providing a robust scientific basis for predictive modelling, risk assessment, and the development of sustainable groundwater protection strategies

Profile

• The successful candidate should have a background in groundwater hydrology, soil physics, engineering, or related areas, with a strong quantitative inclination

• They should have a desire to work experimentally at the interface between physics, chemistry, and engineering, and to combine experimental research with mathematical modeling

• The student will have the opportunity to work in a highly interdisciplinary, fast-paced research environment, to gain skills in several technologies (analytical and computational), to learn about fundamental physical and chemical processes in porous media and subsurface environmental processes in general, and to interact with world-class collaborators in environmental chemistry, reactive transport, and hybrid approaches (process-based models and machine learning)

• The ability to work independently, but also to interact and collaborate within a team, will be a great asset

• An interest for contributing to teaching activities is highly valued

• The project will be supervised by Prof. Dr. Joaquin Jimenez-Martinez (Eawag and ETH Zurich)

Workplace

We offer

• Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society

• You can expect numerous benefits , such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the ASVZ , childcare and attractive pension benefits

chevron_right
Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future .

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

• a CV

• full transcripts from undergraduate studies (both Bachelor and Masters)

• a brief (1-2 page) statement of research interests

• at least 2 (preferably 3) letters of reference

Further information about Subsurface Environmental

Al fine di rafforzare i nostri gruppi di ricerca, stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata, organizzata e orientata al servizio come Office Manager. In questa posizione versatile, sosterrete le nostre cattedrali e i nostri team di ricerca in tutte le questioni amministrative e dare un contributo importante al buon funzionamento dell'istituto. Allo stesso tempo, si partecipa all'organizzazione dei nostri corsi e esami e, insieme ai colleghi, assicurarsi che studenti, ricercatori e docenti siano supportati nel modo migliore possibile. La posizione è permanente e attualmente può essere riempita con un massimo del 70%. Un aumento del carico di lavoro potrebbe essere possibile (su richiesta) in futuro. Non vediamo l'ora di una personalità che voglia assumersi la responsabilità, pensare e plasmare il nostro istituto a lungo termine. • Finanza e progetti: Sostieni la pianificazione del bilancio e la gestione del bilancio, supervisioni progetti di base e di terze parti finanziati, crei fatture e sono la persona di contatto per spese, dichiarazioni di spesa di viaggio, carte di credito e creditori e debitori.
• Personale & Amministrazione: Lei organizza il lavoro e le dimissioni di tutti i dipendenti, assicura il soggiorno liscio dei nostri ospiti e consiglia professori e team di ricerca competenti su questioni amministrative.

• Organizzazione & Eventi: Mantenete la corrispondenza in tedesco e inglese. Incontri di gruppo, workshop e conferenze sono organizzati, programmati e realizzati da voi. I compiti di infrastruttura come l'approvvigionamento, le strutture, i mobili, le risorse di consumo e il coordinamento del posto di lavoro appartengono anche nella vostra zona.
• Comunicazione: Mantenete e aggiornate i nostri canali di comunicazione come siti web e schermi informativi tramite CMS e aiutate a trasmettere informazioni in modo comprensibile e coinvolgente. Profilo Hanno completato la formazione commerciale e portare esperienza professionale in una funzione paragonabile. L'esperienza nell'ambiente universitario è benefica. Inoltre, sono caratterizzati dalle seguenti caratteristiche:
• Lavorano in modo indipendente, strutturato e affidabile e sono felici di assumersi la responsabilità.
• Vi piace il contatto con persone diverse e convincete attraverso il vostro orientamento di servizio pronunciato e il vostro talento organizzativo.

• Comunicano con stile in tedesco e inglese – sia verbalmente che per iscritto.
• Valgono un gepr&auml internazionale, dinamico e scientifico

In this versatile position, you will support our professorships and research teams in all administrative matters and make an important contribution to the smooth operation of the institute. At the same time, you participate in the organization of our courses and examinations and, together with your colleagues, ensure that students, researchers and lecturers are supported in the best possible way. Infrastructure tasks such as procurement, facilities, furniture, consumption resources and workplace coordination also belong in your area.
• Communication: You maintain and update our communication channels such as websites and information screens via CMS and help to convey information in an understandable and engaging manner. Profile They have completed commercial training and bring professional experience in a comparable function. Experience in the university environment is beneficial. In addition, they are characterized by the following characteristics:
• They work independently, structured and reliable and are happy to take responsibility.
• You enjoy contact with different people and convince through your pronounced service orientation and your organizational talent.
• They also keep an overview of various tasks and are interested in administrative and financial issues.
• You communicate openly, respectfully and appreciatively, enjoy working in a team and support each other among your colleagues.
• You have very good knowledge of MS-Office applications; SAP knowledge is an advantage.
• They communicate stylishly in German and English – both verbally and in writing.
• They value an international, dynamic and scientifically gepr&auml

• Sie behalten auch bei vielfältigen Aufgaben den Überblick und interessieren sich für administrative und finanzielle Fragestellungen.

• Sie kommunizieren offen, respektvoll und wertschätzend, arbeiten gerne im Team und unterstützen sich unter Ihren Kolleginnen und Kollegen gegenseitig.

Innerhalb des Vizepräsidiums Finanzen & Controlling fungiert die Sektion Finanzielles Drittmittelreporting als zentrale Fachstelle für die finanzielle Berichterstattung gegenüber nationalen und internationalen Geldgebern. Du liebst Zahlen, denkst in Prozessen und behältst auch bei komplexen Projektreportings den Überblick?

Du möchtest aktiv dazu beitragen, dass Forschungsprojekte finanziell sauber, transparent und regelkonform abgewickelt werden?

Dann wartet hier eine spannende Herausforderung auf dich – mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum als Fachspezialist:in finanzielles Projektreporting (m/w/d).

Stellenbeschreibung

In dieser Rolle bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für ETH-interne Kunden rund um die finanziellen Aspekte drittmittelfinanzierter Projekte. Du berätst Professuren und Projektverantwortliche kompetent und sorgst dafür, dass finanzielle Reportings präzise, termingerecht und regelkonform erstellt werden.

Ein Schwerpunkt deiner Tätigkeit liegt in der finanziellen Berichterstattung von SNF-Forschungsprojekten. Dabei erstellst du innerhalb klarer Zeitvorgaben eine hohe Anzahl an Finanzberichten teilautomatisiert, zuverlässig und in hoher Qualität. Darüber hinaus erstellst du Finanzberichte für weitere nationale und internationale Fördergeber wie Innosuisse oder die Europäische Kommission. Du pflegst aktiv den Kontakt zu allen beteiligten Stellen, koordinierst Abläufe und stellst eine reibungslose sowie fristgerechte Abrechnung sicher.

Du bringst dich zudem in die Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Informationsveranstaltungen ein und unterstützt die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Digitalisierung unserer Finanzprozesse – gerne auch mit innovativen Ansätzen, beispielsweise durch Automatisierung oder den Einsatz neuer Tools.

Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet

descriptionByLocale.en:
Platform Engineer (HPC & AI Infrastructure)

80%-100%, Zurich, permanent

print
Drucken

The High Performance Computing group at ETH Zurich provides world-class HPC and AI/ML infrastructure to researchers across all departments. We operate compute clusters with thousands of CPUs and GPUs, petabytes of storage, and high-speed, low-latency networks across multiple data centres in Switzerland.

As research workloads continue to evolve, we are building a hybrid and open platform that brings together traditional HPC and modern AI workloads.

We are looking for a Platform Engineer with a passion for Linux, automation, and open-source technologies to help us build and operate this infrastructure.

Job description

You will play a key role in automating and operating a large-scale, distributed computing platform. You will work with modern open-source technologies in a vendor-neutral ecosystem and contribute to building a highly reliable and efficient environment for scientific workloads.

What you will do

• Automate infrastructure provisioning and operational workflows using modern IaC tools

• Operate, troubleshoot, and improve Linux systems on both bare metal and virtual infrastructure

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines

• Build and operate on-premise cloud services based on Kubernetes

• Design and maintain observability platforms using metrics, logs, dashboards, and alerting systems

• Support core infrastructure services such as DNS, DHCP, and HTTP

• Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, routing, and firewalls

• Occasional datacenter floor work (racking, cabling, bare-metal troubleshooting and repairs)

Profile

You are a curious and motivated engineer with a passion for automation and new technologies. You enjoy working collaboratively in a team while also being able to take ownership of tasks independently. Strong communication skills in English are essential, enabling you to work effectively in our international environment.

Required technical experience and skills

• Solid experience operating Linux systems in production environments

• Experience automating repetitive operational tasks

• Experience with shell scripting (Bash) and programming in at least one language such as Python, Go or Rust

• Familiarity with Kubernetes, Prometheus and Grafana

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Configuration Management (e.g. Cdist, Ansible, Terraform or similar)

• Basic understanding of TCP/IP networking, routing and firewalls

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with HPC technologies such as InfiniBand networks and multi-GPU systems

• Experience deploying or operating Lustre or other parallel file systems

• Familiarity with Slurm, Spack, and scientific software environments

• Experience with hardware provisioning and out-of-band management technologies such as BMC, IPMI and Redfish

• German language skills

Workplace

We offer

Your job with impact: become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development but also actively contributes to positive change in society.

Working at the Vice Presidency for Infrastructure and Sustainability (VPIN) means helping to shape the future of ETH Zurich – an inspiring, international and innovative institution. Your commitment creates the best conditions for excellence in teaching, research, knowledge transfer and sustainability at ETH Zurich.

In an open, inspiring atmosphere, trust, reliability and mutual respect form the foundation of our collaboration. We offer not only security, but also diverse opportunities for development. With us, you can look forward to meaningful work in an innovative and appreciative environment – one that you can help shape and that opens new perspectives for you.

• Flexible working models with the option to partly work from home

• We live by the principle of Lifelong Learning .

• Benefits such as public transport subscriptions and car sharing, access to the wide range of ASVZ sports

D-ARCH is a leading research and teaching institution dedicated to the advancement of architectural design at the building, urban, landscape and territorial scales. Architectural design is fundamentally holistic in that it utilises a broad epistemological and technical apparatus to give shape to cultural, ecological, environmental, social and economic needs. descriptionByLocale.de:
Policy Dialogue Manager AI & Digital Governance (m/w/d)

80%-100%, Zürich, befristet

print
Drucken

Die rasante Entwicklung von Künstlicher Intelligenz und digitalen Technologien eröffnet neue Chancen für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft, wirft aber zugleich wichtige Fragen zu Sicherheit, Regulierung, Demokratie, Arbeitsmarkt, Bildung und Innovation auf.

Als Policy Dialogue Manager KI & Digitalisierung gestalten Sie den Austausch zwischen führenden Forschenden der ETH Zürich und Entscheidungsträger:innen aus Politik, Verwaltung, Zivilgesellschaft und Wirtschaft. Sie identifizieren relevante politische Fragestellungen, unterstützen Forschende dabei, diese Fragen anzugehen, etablieren und unterhalten Netzwerke und entwickeln Formate, die wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse in politische Entscheidungsprozesse einbringen.

Projekthintergrund

Die Albert Einstein School of Public Policy an der ETH Zürich wurde im Herbst 2025 gegründet. Sie ist ein interdisziplinäres Zentrum, das Public Policy mit Naturwissenschaft und Technologie verbindet, um Lösungen für die grossen gesellschaftlichen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit zu entwickeln.

Durch Forschung, Lehre und Dialog stärken wir die evidenzbasierte Politikgestaltung und fördern hierfür den Austausch zwischen Wissenschaft, Politik, Verwaltung, Zivilgesellschaft und Wirtschaft.

Der Einstein School gehören rund 80 Professor:innen und Gruppenleitende der ETH Zürich und des ETH-Bereichs an.

Thematisch liegt der Fokus der Einstein School auf folgenden Themenfeldern

• KI und Digitalisierung

• Umwelt-, Energie- und Ernährungssysteme

• Planung und gebaute Umwelt

• Öffentliche Gesundheit

• Wirtschaft und Innovation

• Frieden, Konflikt und Sicherheit

Stellenbeschreibung

Sie identifizieren frühzeitig relevante Entwicklungen und politische Fragestellungen im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz und digitale Transformation und Governance, und verfolgen Entwicklungen in der Forschung zu KI und Technologie-Governance. Sie beobachten nationale und internationale Politikentwicklungen im Bereich KI und Digitalisierung und identifizieren Handlungsfelder für die Einstein School.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Policy Dialogue Manager AI & Digital Governance (m/f/d)

80%-100%, Zurigo, temporaneo

Stampato
Stampa

Il rapido sviluppo dell'intelligenza artificiale e delle tecnologie digitali apre nuove opportunità per il business e la società, ma al tempo stesso pone importanti questioni sulla sicurezza, la regolamentazione, la democrazia, il mercato del lavoro, l'istruzione e l'innovazione.

In qualità di Policy Dialogue Manager AI & Digitalization, formerai lo scambio tra i principali ricercatori dell'ETH Zurigo e decisori di politica, amministrazione, società civile e affari. Essi identificano i problemi politici rilevanti, supportano i ricercatori nell'affrontare questi problemi, stabiliscono e mantengono le reti e sviluppano formati che contribuiscono ai risultati scientifici ai processi politici.

Sfondo del progetto

La Albert Einstein School of Public Policy di Zurigo è stata fondata nell'autunno 2025. È un centro interdisciplinare che combina la politica pubblica con la scienza e la tecnologia per sviluppare soluzioni alle grandi sfide sociali del nostro tempo.

Attraverso la ricerca, l'insegnamento e il dialogo, rafforziamo il processo politico basato sulle prove e promuoviamo lo scambio tra scienza, politica, amministrazione, società civile e affari.

La Scuola Einstein comprende circa 80 professori e leader di gruppo dell'ETH Zurigo e del Dominio ETH.

Tematicamente, la Scuola Einstein si concentra sui seguenti argomenti:

• AI e digitalizzazione

• Sistemi ambientali, energetici e alimentari

• Pianificazione e ambiente costruito

• Ö sanità pubblica

• Economia e innovazione

• Pace, conflitto e sicurezza

Descrizione del lavoro

Identificherai gli sviluppi rilevanti e le questioni politiche nel campo dell'intelligenza artificiale e della trasformazione e della governance digitale in una fase iniziale, e seguirai gli sviluppi nella ricerca sull'intelligenza artificiale e sulla governance tecnologica. Osservano gli sviluppi politici nazionali e internazionali nel campo dell'AI e della digitalizzazione e identificano i campi di azione per la Scuola Einstein.

• Essi progettano autonomamente e organizzano formati di dialogo come tavole rotonde, workshop, conferenze e discussioni di fondo con i membri rilevanti della Scuola Einstein.

• Essi costruiscono una rete di attori nell'amministrazione federale, parlamento, cantoni, organizzazioni internazionali, società civile e affari e la mantengono attivamente.

• Si mantiene una rete con attori ETH-internal, per esempio altri centri nel vostro campo.

• Essi consigliano e sostengono i ricercatori dell'ETH di Zurigo in attività all'interfaccia della scienza e della politica.

• Progettano nuovi formati di insegnamento e supportano i membri della Einstein School in progetti di ricerca applicati.

• Scrivono briefing, analisi di sfondo e materiali di comunicazione per diversi gruppi target.

• Essi svolgono attività di controllo nel settore del dialogo politico. In particolare, essi definiscono e attuano le migliori pratiche nel settore del dialogo politico, in stretta collaborazione con altri membri del gruppo di dialogo politico.

• Rappresentano la Einstein School nei confronti degli stakeholder esterni e sono responsabili del posizionamento strategico della scuola nel campo dell'intelligenza artificiale e della digitalizzazione.

• Sostengono l'amministratore delegato della Einstein School nello sviluppo strategico e nell'implementazione della Einstein School, così come nei compiti individuali di gestione.

Questa posizione è limitata a tre anni. Si cerca un'estensione.

Profilo

• Studi universitari completi (Master o PhD), preferibilmente in politica pubblica, scienze politiche, economia, scienze sociali, legge, informatica o discipline correlate.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Policy Dialogue Manager AI & Digital Governance (m/f/d)

80%-100%, Zurich, temporary

Printed
Printing

The rapid development of artificial intelligence and digital technologies opens up new opportunities for business and society, but at the same time raises important questions about security, regulation, democracy, the labour market, education and innovation.

As Policy Dialogue Manager AI & Digitalization, you will shape the exchange between leading researchers at ETH Zurich and decision-makers from politics, administration, civil society and business. They identify relevant policy issues, support researchers in addressing these issues, establish and maintain networks and develop formats that contribute scientific findings to policy-making processes.

Project background

The Albert Einstein School of Public Policy at ETH Zurich was founded in autumn 2025. It is an interdisciplinary centre that combines public policy with science and technology to develop solutions to the great societal challenges of our time.

Through research, teaching and dialogue, we strengthen evidence-based policymaking and promote exchange between science, politics, administration, civil society and business.

The Einstein School comprises around 80 professors and group leaders from ETH Zurich and the ETH Domain.

Thematically, the Einstein School focuses on the following topics:

• AI and digitalisation

• Environmental, energy and food systems

• Planning and Built Environment

• Öpublic health

• Economy and innovation

• Peace, conflict and security

Job description

You will identify relevant developments and policy issues in the field of artificial intelligence and digital transformation and governance at an early stage, and follow developments in research on AI and technology governance. They observe national and international policy developments in the field of AI and digitalization and identify fields of action for the Einstein School.

• They independently design and organize dialogue formats such as roundtables, workshops, conferences and background discussions with the relevant members of the Einstein School.

• They build up a network of actors in the federal administration, parliament, cantons, international organizations, civil society and business and actively maintain it.

• You maintain a network with ETH-internal actors, for example other centers in your field.

• They advise and support researchers at ETH Zurich in activities at the interface of science and politics.

• They design new teaching formats and support members of the Einstein School in applied research projects.

• They write briefings, background analyses and communication materials for different target groups.

• They take overarching activities in the area of policy dialogue was. In particular, they define and implement best practices in the area of policy dialogue, in close cooperation with other members of the Policy Dialogue team.

• They represent Einstein School vis-à-vis external stakeholders and are responsible for the strategic positioning of the school in the field of AI and digitalization.

• They support the managing director of the Einstein School in the strategy development and implementation of the Einstein School, as well as in individual management tasks.

This position is limited to three years. An extension is sought.

Profile

• Completed university studies (Master or PhD), preferably in public policy, political science, economics, social sciences, law, computer science or related disciplines.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Gestionnaire du dialogue sur les politiques en matière d'IA et de gouvernance numérique (m/f/d)

80%-100%, Zurich, temporaire

Imprimé
Impression

Le développement rapide de l'intelligence artificielle et des technologies numériques ouvre de nouvelles perspectives pour les entreprises et la société, mais soulève en même temps des questions importantes concernant la sécurité, la réglementation, la démocratie, le marché du travail, l'éducation et l'innovation.

En tant que responsable du dialogue politique, AI & Digitalization, vous façonnerez l'échange entre les chercheurs de premier plan de l'ETH Zurich et les décideurs politiques, administratifs, de la société civile et des entreprises. Ils identifient les enjeux stratégiques pertinents, aident les chercheurs à s'attaquer à ces enjeux, établissent et maintiennent des réseaux et élaborent des formats qui contribuent aux résultats scientifiques des processus d'élaboration des politiques.

Contexte du projet

La Albert Einstein School of Public Policy de l'ETH Zurich a été fondée à l'automne 2025. C'est un centre interdisciplinaire qui combine les politiques publiques et la science et la technologie pour trouver des solutions aux grands défis sociétaux de notre époque.

Par la recherche, l'enseignement et le dialogue, nous renforçons l'élaboration de politiques fondées sur des données probantes et encourageons les échanges entre les sciences, la politique, l'administration, la société civile et les entreprises.

L'école Einstein compte environ 80 professeurs et chefs de groupe de l'ETH Zurich et du domaine de l'ETH.

Thématiquement, l'école Einstein se concentre sur les sujets suivants:

• AI et numérisation

• Systèmes environnementaux, énergétiques et alimentaires

• Planification et environnement bâti

• Santé publique

• Économie et innovation

• Paix, conflits et sécurité

Description de l'emploi

Vous identifierez les développements pertinents et les questions de politique dans le domaine de l'intelligence artificielle, de la transformation numérique et de la gouvernance à un stade précoce, et suivrez l'évolution de la recherche sur l'IA et la gouvernance technologique. Ils observent l'évolution des politiques nationales et internationales dans le domaine de l'IA et de la numérisation et identifient les domaines d'action pour l'école Einstein.

• Ils conçoivent et organisent de façon indépendante des dialogues tels que des tables rondes, des ateliers, des conférences et des discussions avec les membres concernés de l'école Einstein.

• Ils constituent un réseau d'acteurs au sein de l'administration fédérale, du parlement, des cantons, des organisations internationales, de la société civile et des entreprises et le maintiennent activement.

• Vous maintenez un réseau avec des acteurs internes de l'ETH, par exemple d'autres centres dans votre domaine.

• Ils conseillent et soutiennent les chercheurs de l'ETH Zurich dans des activités à l'interface de la science et de la politique.

• Ils conçoivent de nouveaux formats d'enseignement et soutiennent les membres de l'école Einstein dans des projets de recherche appliquée.

• Ils rédigent des exposés, des analyses de base et du matériel de communication pour différents groupes cibles.

• Ils mènent des activités globales dans le domaine du dialogue politique. En particulier, ils définissent et mettent en œuvre les meilleures pratiques dans le domaine du dialogue politique, en étroite coopération avec d'autres membres de l'équipe de dialogue politique.

• Ils représentent l'école Einstein vis-à-vis des intervenants externes et sont responsables du positionnement stratégique de l'école dans le domaine de l'IA et de la numérisation.

• Ils soutiennent le directeur général de l'école Einstein dans le développement et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de l'école Einstein, ainsi que dans les tâches de gestion individuelle.

Ce poste est limité à trois ans. Une prolongation est demandée.

Profil

• Études universitaires terminées (maîtrise ou doctorat), de préférence en politique publique, sciences politiques, économie, sciences sociales, droit, informatique ou disciplines connexes.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Senior NLP Data Scientist 100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato stampa Druppo Lo Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC) è un'infrastruttura di ricerca nazionale nella scienza dei dati e nell'intelligenza artificiale (AI) nel dominio ETH, con EPFL e ETH Zurich come partner fondatori. Il suo mandato è quello di sostenere laboratori accademici, ospedali, industria e parti interessate del settore pubblico, tra cui le amministrazioni cantonali e federali, attraverso il loro intero percorso di scienza dei dati, dalla raccolta e gestione dei dati al machine learning, AI e industrializzazione. Con un grande team multidisciplinare di professionisti in tre sedi (Lausanne, Zurigo, Villigen), SDSC fornisce competenze e servizi in ambiti come la salute e le scienze biomediche, l'energia e la sostenibilità, il clima e l'ambiente, e le infrastrutture scientifiche su larga scala. Il candidato sarà integrato in un ambiente dinamico e ricco, con persone provenienti da diversi campi e competenze, e sarà parte del team di ricerca SDSC. Il team di ricerca della SDSC comprende più di 35 scienziati di dati, cercando di applicare nuovi metodi AI/ML per risolvere i problemi del mondo reale nei settori accademici e pubblici. Vedere per un'idea di alcune delle nostre collaborazioni di ricerca accademica. Sfondo del progetto In qualità di Senior Data Scientist con competenze in NLP e LLM che lavorano nel team di Ricerca, aiuterà ricercatori e altri collaboratori in accademia o nel settore pubblico in Svizzera a sfruttare metodologie all'avanguardia. Aiuterai collaboratori di vari campi a realizzare progetti basati su dati testuali o correlati (potenzialmente multi-modali), e in particolare in scienze sanitarie e biomediche, clima e ambiente, energia e sostenibilità, e scienze sociali. • Lavorare su progetti che richiedono competenze con metodi basati su LLM e NLP con collaboratori del settore accademico e pubblico.
• Superare e collaborare con gli studenti a diversi livelli, fornendo guida e supervisione.
• Impegnarsi con diversi stakeholder, tra cui i ricercatori di vari domini e altri professionisti.
• Prepara pubblicazioni scientifiche per conferenze e riviste di alto livello.
• Valutazione delle proposte di progetto. Profilo
• Un dottorato è un must have - idealmente in NLP.
• Esperienza con grandi modelli linguistici e/o altri modelli di fondazione. In particolare, l'esperienza rilevante comprende modelli di formazione o perfezionamento (lingua) di diverse dimensioni, familiarità con le caratteristiche dei principali modelli di lingua e la loro applicabilità di dominio, e l'esperienza con progetti di dati su larga scala.

Senior NLP Data Scientist

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

The Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC) is a national research infrastructure in data science and artificial intelligence (AI) within the ETH domain, with EPFL and ETH Zurich as founding partners. Its mandate is to support academic labs, hospitals, industry and public sector stakeholders, including cantonal and federal administrations, through their entire data science journey, from the collection and management of data to machine learning, AI, and industrialization. With a large multidisciplinary team of professionals across three locations (Lausanne, Zurich, Villigen), the SDSC provides expertise and services across domains such as health and biomedical sciences, energy and sustainability, climate and environment, and large-scale scientific infrastructure.

The candidate will be integrated into a dynamic and rich environment, with people from different fields and expertise, and will be part of SDSC's Research team. The Research team at the SDSC comprises more than 35 data scientists, seeking to apply novel AI/ML methods to solve real-world problems in the academic and public sectors. See for an idea of some of our academic research collaborations.

Project background

As a Senior Data Scientist with expertise in NLP and LLMs working in the Research team, you will help researchers and other collaborators in academia or the public sector in Switzerland leverage state-of-the-art methodologies. You will help collaborators from various fields carry out projects based on textual or related data (potentially multi-modal), and notably in health and biomedical sciences, climate and environment, energy and sustainability, and social sciences.

This typically involves actively exchanging with collaborators and domain experts to understand the precise desiderata of the project, determining which approaches, formulations, and language models are most effective to achieve the desired goals, implementing the corresponding algorithms, performing the evaluations hand-in-hand with collaborators, and eventually releasing open-source code and writing research papers when appropriate.

Job description

• Working on projects requiring expertise with LLM-based and NLP methods with collaborators from the academic and public sectors.

• Supervise and collaborate with students at different levels, providing guidance and supervision.

• Engage with diverse stakeholders, including researchers across various domains and other professionals.

• Prepare scientific publications for top-tier domain conferences and journals.

• Evaluating project proposals.

Profile

• A PhD is a must have - ideally in NLP.

• Experience with large language models and/or other foundation models. In particular, relevant experience includes training or fine-tuning (language) models of different sizes, familiarity with the characteristics of main language models and their domain applicability, and experience with large-scale data projects.

• Beyond prompt engineering techniques, familiarity with parameter-efficient fine-tuning, agentic methods, advanced usages, and transfer methodologies for large language models would be of particular interest.

• Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, and familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, NLTK, LLM environments, tools for agentic AI, etc.

• Demonstration of research excellence through publications in relevant venues.

• Proven experience in interdisciplinary projects and environments in which developments are guided by domain research questions.

We are thus seeking candidates with a strong curiosity about learning from other non-technical disciplines and proficient in presenting methods and results to non-technical audiences.

Workplace

We offer

Professional Development:

• Opportunities to publish contributions to research projects in high-impact journals

• Possibility to travel and present work in international venues

• Involvement in supervision of MSc

descriptionByLocale.it:
PhD Researcher - Bone Organoids 100%, Singapore, fixed-term Drucken The Singapore-ETH Centre was established in 2010 by ETH Zurich - The Swiss Federal Institute of Technology and Singapore’s National Research Foundation (NRF), as part of the NRF’s CREATE campus. As ETH Zurich's only research centre outside of Switzerland, the centre has strengthened the research capacity of ETH Zurich to develop sustainable solutions to global challenges in Switzerland, Singapore and the surrounding regions. Set in Asia, in a rapidly urbanising region, the Singapore-ETH Centre aims to provide practical solutions to some of the most pressing challenges on urban sustainability, resilience and health through its programmes: Future Cities Lab Global (FCL Global) and Future Health Technologies (FHT) . The centre serves as an intellectual hub for research, bringing together principal investigators and researchers from diverse disciplines and backgrounds. To promote the exchange of ideas and expertise, our researchers actively collaborate with universities and research institutes and engage with industry and government agencies to translate knowledge to practical solutions to real-world problems. Project background Advanced Patient-derived 3D Bone Organoids for In Vitro Osteoporosis Research Fragility fractures are among the most serious consequences of impaired skeletal health in older adults, often leading to reduced mobility, loss of independence, and long-term disability. Although current standards of care provide important tools for assessing skeletal health and fracture risk, patient-specific biological responses to altered bone remodelling, mechanical loading, and inflammation remain difficult to capture in conventional assessment workflows. This is particularly relevant in osteoporosis and related age-associated bone disorders, where patients can differ substantially in bone remodelling activity, inflammatory status, bone formation capacity, osteoclast activity, and capacity for mechanoadaptation. A better understanding of these differences could support more personalised strategies for osteoporosis research and fracture prevention. Building on the dynamic bone organoid culture platform developed in the Laboratory for Bone Biomechanics at ETH Zurich, this PhD project will contribute to the fracture prevention component by developing advanced patient-derived organoids for invitro osteoporosis research. The doctoral researcher will establish workflows to 3D print patient-derived mesenchymal stromal cells, guide their osteogenic differentiation under dynamic mechanical stimulation, and coculture with peripheral blood mononuclear cells. These models will be used to study osteoporosis-related bone remodelling, immune-bone interactions, donor-specific osteoporotic phenotypes, and mineralisation dynamics, including the influence of age-related comorbidities on bone remodelling. Biological readouts from the organoids will contribute to predictive modelling frameworks for bone remodelling trajectories and fracture risk, supporting the advancement of human-relevant in vitro models for precision musculoskeletal care. Job description The PhD candidate will interact closely with engineers, clinicians, biologists, computational researchers, to generate robust biological datasets for personalised modelling of bone remodelling and fracture prevention. Some key components in the work are:
• Development of patient-derived organoids for in vitro osteoporosis research.
• Integration of peripheral blood mononuclear cells into mature bone organoids to model immune-bone interactions, monocyte-derived osteoclast activity, inflammation, and bone remodelling.
• Investigation of donor-specific differences and mineralisation dynamics associated with age, sex, and relevant comorbidities.
• Characterisation of osteoporosis-related organoid phenotypes using molecular, biochemical, histological, imaging, and microscopy-based techniques. Profile

descriptionByLocale.it:
PhD Researcher - Micro-Multiphysics 100%, Singapore, fixed-term Drucken The Singapore-ETH Centre was established in 2010 by ETH Zurich - The Swiss Federal Institute of Technology and Singapore’s National Research Foundation (NRF), as part of the NRF’s CREATE campus. As ETH Zurich's only research centre outside of Switzerland, the centre has strengthened the research capacity of ETH Zurich to develop sustainable solutions to global challenges in Switzerland, Singapore and the surrounding regions. Set in Asia, in a rapidly urbanising region, the Singapore-ETH Centre aims to provide practical solutions to some of the most pressing challenges on urban sustainability, resilience and health through its programmes: Future Cities Lab Global (FCL Global) and Future Health Technologies (FHT) . The centre serves as an intellectual hub for research, bringing together principal investigators and researchers from diverse disciplines and backgrounds. To promote the exchange of ideas and expertise, our researchers actively collaborate with universities and research institutes and engage with industry and government agencies to translate knowledge to practical solutions to real-world problems. Project background Micro-Multiphysics Agent-Based Modelling for Simulation of Patient-Specific Bone Remodelling Fragility fractures are among the most serious consequences of impaired skeletal health in older adults and often lead to reduced mobility, loss of independence, and long-term disability. Although current standards of care provide important tools for assessing skeletal health and fracture risk, they do not fully capture how individual differences in bone remodelling, inflammation, mechanical loading, and biological tissue response influence fracture progression over time. Osteoporosis and related age-associated bone disorders are highly heterogeneous, with patients differing in bone formation capacity, osteoclast activity, inflammatory status, mineralisation dynamics, and capacity for mechanoadaptation. Computational models that integrate these biological and clinical differences could support more personalised strategies for fracture prevention and musculoskeletal care. Building on the dynamic bone organoid culture platform developed in the Laboratory for Bone Biomechanics at ETH Zurich, this project aims to develop micro-multiphysics agent-based models (micro-MPA) that link patient-derived organoid readouts with clinical and imaging data. The doctoral researcher will develop computational workflows to simulate bone remodelling processes, mechanical-cytokine microenvironments, cellular dynamics, and patient-specific fracture risk trajectories. Biological outputs from patient-derived 3D bone organoids, including mineralisation dynamics, osteoclast activity, immune-bone interactions, inflammatory profiles, and mechanical response, will be translated into model parameters and integrated with relevant clinical datasets. The resulting modelling framework will support the prediction of patient-specific bone remodelling trajectories and fracture risk under different biological and mechanical conditions, contributing to data-driven and human-relevant approaches for precision fracture prevention. Job description The PhD candidate will interact closely with engineers, clinicians, biologists, computational researchers, to generate a micro-MPA modelling framework supporting prediction of patient-specific bone remodelling trajectories and fracture risk.
