PhD in land use modeling 100%, Zurich, fixed-term print Drucken The Chair for Planning of Landscape and Urban Systems (PLUS) at the Institute for Spatial and Landscape Planning, ETH Zurich, is a young, dynamic and interdisciplinary research team addressing problems of sustainable spatial and landscape development. Starting in September 2026 or by mutual agreement, we are looking for a PhD in land use modeling. Project background The 4-year PhD position is funded by the NCCR CLIM+ program ( NCCR CLIM+ — Climate Extremes and Society ), financed by the Swiss National Science Foundation. NCCR CLIM+ supports Switzerland in the transformation towards a climate-resilient society. Together with stakeholders, the interdisciplinary NCCR CLIM+ research community tackles unexplored solution spaces to the climate crisis and develops a blueprint for actionable climate research worldwide. The project will be carried out in a collaborative environment between WSL, Agroscope, and ETH Zürich, providing extensive technical know-how and interdisciplinary expertise in hydrology, forestry and agriculture. Job description
• The PhD student will further develop and apply a land use model, evoland-plus (pattern-based land use change model coupled with WASIM and FORCLIM), to forecast future changes in biodiversity and ecosystem services under various socio-economic and climate scenarios
• The candidate will use both statistical and process-based approaches to better represent hydrology, forest dynamics and agricultural production and their effects on land use and ecosystem services. In particular, the candidate should be interested in applying the model to contribute to robust storylines of self-consistent plausible futures encompassing the physical and social dimensions of extreme climate outcomes The results will be transformed into policy guidance reports and other documentation. Profile
• We are seeking a highly motivated candidate with a MSc degree in Land System Science, Environmental Sciences, Geography, Agricultural Science or related discipline, who has a deep understanding of social-ecological systems, experience in programming and has very good GIS skills
• Ideal candidates have experience with ecosystem services modeling, forest dynamic modeling, hydrological modeling or species distribution modeling, and interest in working on the interfaces between these topics
• Furthermore, the applicant should have a good command of English (both written and spoken) and should be willing to communicate with and work in a large interdisciplinary project. German or French is an advantage as a second language The full-time position is funded for four years. Salary and social benefits are provided according to ETH Zurich rules. Workplace Workplace We offer
• A stimulating, interdisciplinary research environment in a dynamic and international team, see ALEA Award 2018 – Finalist Adrienne Grêt-Regame
• Close collaboration with leading experts in social-ecological systems, computational text analysis, and well-being research
• Excellent working conditions at ETH Zurich, one of the world’s leading universities
• Opportunities for academic development, publication, and international networking chevron_right Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich We value diversity and sustainability In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future . Curious? So are we. We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:
• Curriculum vitae

Fachspezialist:in Konfliktmanagement und Mediation (m/w/d) 100%, Zürich, unbefristet print Drucken Die Abteilung Diversity und Kooperation ist im Schulleitungsbereich des Vizepräsidiums für Personalentwicklung und Leadership (VPPL) angesiedelt. Im Rahmen der Weiterentwicklung des organisationsweiten Respekt- und Konfliktmanagementsystems der ETH Zürich wird in der Abteilung Diversity und Kooperation die neu verankerte Klärungsstelle aufgebaut und operativ gestärkt. Als Teil des VPPL stehen wir für eine inklusive Kultur und Leadership ein, begegnen unseren Mitmenschen auf Augenhöhe, übernehmen gerne Verantwortung, denken und arbeiten vernetzt und haben eine Leidenschaft für innovative Ansätze – dies mit Mut und Leichtigkeit. Unsere Vision: Gemeinsam befähigen wir Menschen, das Potenzial ihrer selbst und anderer zu entfalten. Hier gelangen Sie zu einem kurzen Video-Interview mit unserer Vizepräsidentin Julia Dannath. Als Fachspezialist:in Konfliktmanagement und Mediation übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Funktion in der Bearbeitung, Steuerung und strukturellen Einbettung komplexer Konflikt- und Beschwerdekonstellationen in der gesamten Institution. Sie gewährleisten die qualifizierte Konzeption, Führung und Dokumentation strukturierter Klärungsprozesse in anspruchsvollen Einzelfällen und stellen sicher, dass diese in kohärenter Weise in das übergeordnete institutionelle System eingebettet sind. Stellenbeschreibung Beratung & Befähigung
• Sie beraten Führungspersonen, Mitarbeitende sowie Organisationseinheiten in komplexen Konfliktlagen und nehmen dabei eine klar strukturierende, allparteiliche und prozessverantwortliche Rolle ein. Im Zentrum steht die professionelle Steuerung von Klärungsprozessen unter Berücksichtigung organisationaler, kultureller und struktureller Rahmenbedingungen.
• Ein zentraler Bestandteil Ihres Mandats ist die Beratung und Befähigung von Führungskräften im Umgang mit Konflikten, Eskalationsdynamiken und organisationsbezogenen Entscheidungs- und Verantwortungssituationen. Diese Funktion ist integraler Bestandteil der institutionellen Governance im Bereich Respekt- und Konfliktmanagement.
• Gleichzeitig übernehmen Sie die fachliche Prozessberatung und Systemunterstützung anderer interner Anlauf- und Beratungsstellen. Sie tragen damit zur Systematisierung und Weiterentwicklung organisationsweiter Vorgehensweisen im Umgang mit Respekt- und Konfliktthemen bei. Prävention & Transfer
• Ihre Tätigkeit geht explizit über die Einzelfallbearbeitung hinaus. Sie verstehen Konflikte auch als systemische Indikatoren organisationaler Dynamiken.
• Sie stellen sicher, dass Erkenntnisse aus der Klärungsarbeit systematisch erhoben, verdichtet und in geeigneter Form in die Organisation rückgeführt werden. Damit leisten Sie einen Beitrag zur strukturellen Lernfähigkeit der Institution sowie zur Weiterentwicklung von Governance-, Präventions- und Qualitätsstandards.

Positionierung & Weiterentwicklung
• Sie wirken aktiv an der Positionierung und Weiterentwicklung der Klärungsstelle als strategisch relevanten Pfeiler institutioneller Steuerung im Bereich Respekt- und Konfliktmanagement mit.
• Dabei verbinden Sie operative Fallverantwortung mit systemischer Reflexion, konzeptioneller Weiterentwicklung und organisationsweiter Perspektivbildung. Profil

Descrizione Posizione del dottorato in Interazione Umana-Computer e Realtà estesa nella progettazione architettonica e nella fabbricazione 100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato stampa Druppo Interazione umana-Computer in Architettura e Digital Fabrication Questa posizione di dottorato a tempo pieno, a tempo pieno, dura quattro anni ed è incorporata all'interno dell'ambiente di ricerca interdisciplinare presso la Professorship of Architecture and Human Augmentation presso ETH Zürich. Siamo alla ricerca di un ricercatore altamente guidato e motivato con un forte impegno nella ricerca rigorosa e applicata in un ambiente accademico interdisciplinare. La ricerca si concentra sull'interazione uomo-computer (HCI) nella progettazione architettonica e nella fabbricazione, con una particolare enfasi sulla realtà estesa (XR), la visione della macchina e la collaborazione umana-robot. Sfondo del progetto La ricerca indaga su come strumenti computazionali interattivi, realtà estesa (XR), e sistemi robotici possono aumentare l'agenzia umana nella produzione architettonica. Esamina i ruoli delle interfacce, dei sistemi di feedback e dell'interazione corposa in intenti di progettazione, del comportamento materiale e dell'esecuzione robotica attraverso flussi di lavoro di progettazione-fabricazione. In particolare, il lavoro si svilupperà all'interno di quei flussi di ricerca:
• sviluppare strumenti e flussi di lavoro per valutare in modo efficiente i materiali scartati
• creare un inventario digitale dei componenti recuperati
• lo sviluppo di rappresentazioni computazionali di processi di assemblaggio e smontaggio
• la creazione di una pipeline robusta che collega questo inventario ai modelli CAD Descrizione del lavoro Come candidato di dottorato, condurrai studi, progetti e studi originali, svilupperai e valuterai prototipi, analizza i dati e diffonderai i risultati attraverso pubblicazioni e presentazioni. Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con il team di ricerca e partner, contribuire alla vita di laboratorio, e sostenere l'insegnamento e la supervisione degli studenti. Le attività includono:

PhD Position in Human–Computer Interaction and Extended Reality in Architectural Design and Fabrication 100%, Zurich, fixed-term print Drucken Human–Computer Interaction in Architecture and Digital Fabrication This fully funded, full-time PhD position spans four years and is embedded within the interdisciplinary research environment at the Professorship of Architecture and Human Augmentation at ETH Zürich. We are looking for a highly self-driven and motivated researcher with a strong commitment to rigorous and applied research within an interdisciplinary academic environment. The research focuses on human–computer interaction (HCI) in architectural design and fabrication, with a particular emphasis on extended reality (XR), machine vision, and human-robot collaboration. Project background The research investigates how interactive computational tools, extended reality (XR), and robotic systems can augment human agency in architectural production. It examines the roles of interfaces, feedback systems, and embodied interaction in bridging design intent, material behaviour, and robotic execution across design-to-fabrication workflows. Specifically, the work will develop within those research streams:
• developing tools and workflows to efficiently assess discarded materials
• creating a digital inventory of reclaimed components
• developing computational representations of assembly and disassembly processes
• establishing a robust pipeline linking this inventory to CAD models Job description As a PhD candidate, you will conduct original research, design and run studies, develop and evaluate prototypes, analyze data, and disseminate results through publications and presentations. You will collaborate closely with the research team and partners, contribute to lab life, and support teaching and student supervision. Tasks include:
• Conduct independent research within the project scope
• Perform literature reviews and maintain awareness of related work
• Design and run experiments/case studies
• Document research thoroughly (version control, lab notebooks, protocols, datasets)
• Collect, clean, and analyze data using appropriate methods (e.g., qualitative coding, statistics, simulation, ML )
• Publish results in peer-reviewed venues (conferences/journals) and contribute to paper writing
• Support lab operations as needed (maintaining equipment, onboarding, shared infrastructure) Teaching:
• Assist with teaching (TA, tutorials, crit sessions) and supervise student projects
• Mentor junior students (Bachelor/Master) and contribute to studio/course activities Software/Engineering:
• Implement research code and maintain repositories (testing, documentation, reproducibility) Grants/reporting:
• Contribute to grant writing, progress reports, and project administration Profile
• You hold an architectural or advanced technical degree corresponding to FHEQ Level 7
• You have a strong interest in programming and, ideally, experience with Python and C# coding language
• You are proficient in 3D modelling environments and XR software; experience with Rhinoceros, Grasshopper and Unity is an advantage
• Experience in robotic fabrication, digital fabrication, or human–robot interaction is highly desirable
• Familiarity with XR technologies, UX development, or experimental prototyping is an asset
• You are fluent in English (written and spoken) Workplace Workplace We offer
• The opportunity to pursue doctoral research at a world-renowned academic institution
• Access to state-of-the-art computational, XR, and robotic fabrication infrastructure
• Close collaboration with researchers across architecture, robotics, computer science, and engineering
• An engaged international community of researchers and educators
• Professional development and networking opportunities through academic and industry collaborations chevron_right Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich We value diversity

Descrizione Position du doctorat en interaction homme-ordinateur et réalité étendue en conception architecturale et fabrication 100%, Zurich, durée déterminée imprimer Drucken Interaction humaine-informatique dans l'architecture et la fabrication numérique Ce poste de doctorat à temps plein et entièrement financé s'étend sur quatre ans et est intégré dans l'environnement de recherche interdisciplinaire au Professeur d'architecture et d'augmentation humaine à ETH Zürich. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un chercheur hautement motivé et motivé qui s'engage fortement dans la recherche rigoureuse et appliquée dans un milieu universitaire interdisciplinaire. La recherche se concentre sur l'interaction homme-ordinateur (HCI) dans la conception et la fabrication architecturales, en mettant particulièrement l'accent sur la réalité étendue (XR), la vision de la machine et la collaboration homme-robot. Contexte du projet La recherche examine comment les outils informatiques interactifs, la réalité étendue (XR) et les systèmes robotiques peuvent augmenter l'organisme humain dans la production architecturale. Il examine les rôles des interfaces, des systèmes de rétroaction et de l'interaction incarnée dans l'intention de la conception, le comportement matériel et l'exécution robotique dans les processus de conception à fabrication. Plus précisément, les travaux se développeront dans ces domaines de recherche :
• développer des outils et des flux de travail pour évaluer efficacement les matériaux rejetés
• créer un inventaire numérique des composants récupérés
• développer des représentations informatiques des processus de montage et de démontage
• établir un pipeline robuste reliant cet inventaire aux modèles CAO; Description du poste En tant que candidat au doctorat, vous effectuerez des recherches originales, concevoirez et exécuterez des études, développerez et évaluerez des prototypes, analyserez des données et diffuserez les résultats au moyen de publications et de présentations. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec l'équipe de recherche et les partenaires, contribuerez à la vie en laboratoire et soutenirez l'enseignement et la supervision des étudiants. Les tâches comprennent :

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione dottorale nello sviluppo degli indicatori sociali con dati basati sul testo e spaziali 100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato stampa Druppo La Cattedra di Pianificazione del Paesaggio e dei Sistemi Urbani (PLUS) presso l’Istituto per lo Sviluppo Spaziale e Paesaggio, ETH Zurich, sta cercando un ricercatore di dottorato altamente motivato (100%) per aderire al progetto “DEPOPLAND: Drivers and trajectories of social-ecological change in depopulating paesaggi rurali”, finanziato dalla Fondazione svizzera per la scienza nazionale. Qui Sfondo del progetto Lo spopolamento rurale sta emergendo come una delle trasformazioni globali del XXI secolo, con profonde conseguenze sia per gli ecosistemi che per il benessere umano. Il progetto DEPOPLAND mira a fornire la prima analisi sistematica su scala globale delle dinamiche ecologiche e sociali nel depopolare i paesaggi rurali, identificare le traiettorie del cambiamento e i loro driver sottostanti. A tal fine, il progetto promuove un approccio integrato e basato sui dati per analizzare i sistemi social-ecologici, combinando diverse fonti di dati e metodi computazionali avanzati per scoprire dinamiche a lungo termine degli ecosistemi e del benessere umano. DEPOPLAND è altamente interdisciplinare, che riunisce competenze dall'ecologia del paesaggio, geografia fisica e umana, scienza del sistema terrestre e linguistica computazionale. Il progetto è realizzato in collaborazione con i partner dell'ETH di Zurigo, dell'Università di Zurigo e delle Università di Kassel e Göttingen. Descrizione del lavoro Il ricercatore di dottorato lavorerà principalmente sui Pacchetti di lavoro 1 e 3, concentrandosi sulla modellazione e l'analisi delle traiettorie di benessere oggettivo e soggettivo utilizzando analisi di testo spaziali e computazionali.
• Identificare il restringimento e la crescita dei paesaggi rurali a livello globale utilizzando set di dati su larga scala e analisi spaziale
• Compilare, armonizzare e analizzare le serie temporali specifiche delle regioni di indicatori oggettivi e soggettivi di benessere
• Sviluppare e applicare flussi di lavoro di analisi del testo computazionale per ricavare indicatori spaziali e temporalmente espliciti del benessere soggettivo da grandi dataset basati sul testo (ad esempio database di notizie globali come GDELT o altri archivi di notizie)
• Progettare e implementare modelli di machine learning per analizzare e prevedere indicatori di benessere
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con altri membri del progetto (compreso un secondo studente di dottorato che lavora su traiettorie ecologiche)
• Presentare i risultati a conferenze e pubblicazione in riviste peer-reviewed Profilo qualifiche richieste:
• Laurea magistrale in geografia, scienze sociali, pianificazione del paesaggio, economia, scienza dei dati o un campo correlato
• Forte interesse per la ricerca sul benessere, gli indicatori sociali o le interazioni umane-ambientali
• Esperienza con l'analisi computazionale dei dati di testo (ad esempio elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, estrazione del testo o scienze sociali computazionali)
• Esperienza con analisi e programmazione dei dati spaziali (ad esempio Python o R)
• Ottimo comando dell'inglese (scritto e parlato) e forti competenze di lavoro di squadra Attività aggiuntive:

• Esperienza di lavoro con i dati dell'indagine o gli indicatori sociali

Il progetto si concentra sulla generazione armonica ad alto ordine (HHG) in liquidi a gas nobile, in particolare elio liquido. Questa ricerca mira a esplorare un nuovo regime di dinamiche elettroni ultraveloci in materia condensata e a colmare il divario tra la fase gassosa e la fase liquida HHG. La posizione offre l'opportunità di lavorare all'avanguardia della spettroscopia dell'attosecondo utilizzando sistemi laser ultraveloci all'avanguardia e tecnologia criogenica. Questa posizione di dottorato di 4 anni è finanziata dalla nostra sovvenzione SNSF. La generazione armonica di alto ordine è diventata una pietra angolare della scienza dell'attosecondo, consentendo l'osservazione delle dinamiche elettrone sulle loro scale temporali naturali. Mentre HHG è ben compresa nei gas e sempre più esplorata nei solidi, la sua estensione ai liquidi offre intriganti opportunità di studiare elettroni spargimento e delocalizzazione proprietà. I liquidi Noble-gas e l'elio liquido in particolare forniscono una piattaforma unica: combinano la semplicità dei sistemi atomici con la densità della materia condensata. Il loro elettrone relativamente lungo significa percorsi liberi offrono l'accesso a un regime in cui la fisica del campo forte può essere studiata in condizioni intermedie tra gas e liquidi molecolari. Questo progetto mira a stabilire la spettroscopia HHG in liquidi nobili, indagare il ruolo di spargimento elettrone e coerenza, ed esplorare nuovi fenomeni come HHG nella fase superfluida dell'elio.

descriptionByLocale.en:
PhD position on high-order harmonic generation spectroscopy in noble-gas liquids 100%, Zurich, fixed-term print Drucken We are offering a PhD position in attosecond science and strong-field physics at the Laboratory of Physical Chemistry, ETH Zürich. The project focuses on high-order harmonic generation (HHG) in noble-gas liquids, in particular liquid helium. This research aims to explore a new regime of ultrafast electron dynamics in condensed matter and to bridge the gap between gas-phase and liquid-phase HHG. The position offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of attosecond spectroscopy using state-of-the-art ultrafast laser systems and cryogenic technology. This 4-year PhD position is funded by our SNSF grant. Project background High-order harmonic generation has become a cornerstone of attosecond science, enabling the observation of electron dynamics on their natural timescales. While HHG is well understood in gases and increasingly explored in solids, its extension to liquids offers intriguing opportunities to study electron scattering and delocalization properties. Noble-gas liquids, and liquid helium in particular, provide a unique platform: they combine the simplicity of atomic systems with the density of condensed matter. Their relatively long electron mean free paths offer access to a regime where strong-field physics can be studied under conditions intermediate between gases and molecular liquids. This project aims to establish HHG spectroscopy in noble liquids, investigate the role of electron scattering and coherence, and explore new phenomena such as HHG in the superfluid phase of helium. Job description
• Design and perform experiments on high-order harmonic generation in liquid and gas-phase targets
• Develop and operate cryogenic liquid-jet systems for noble-gas liquids
• Implement advanced ultrafast laser techniques (e.g., few-cycle pulses, two-colour fields, CEP stabilization)
• Analyze experimental data to extract information on electron dynamics (cut-off scaling, phase, emission times)
• Contribute to the development of new experimental methods in attosecond spectroscopy
• Present results at international conferences and publish in high-impact journals Profile
• Master’s degree in physics, physical chemistry, or a closely related field
• Strong interest in ultrafast laser science, attosecond physics, or strong-field phenomena
• Experimental skills and motivation to work on complex laboratory setups
• Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative research team
• Good communication skills in English (spoken and written) Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage: ultrafast optics, nonlinear optics, HHG/strong-field physics, vacuum technology, spectroscopy, or scientific programming (Python, MATLAB). Workplace Workplace We offer
• A fully funded PhD position at ETH Zürich, one of the world’s leading universities
• Access to state-of-the-art ultrafast laser systems and experimental infrastructure
• A stimulating, international research environment with strong collaborations
• Opportunities to attend international conferences and build a scientific network

chevron left Übersicht chevron left Übersicht PhD-Position zur hochrangigen Harmonischengenerationsspektroskopie in Edelgasflüssigkeiten 100%, Zürich, Festdruck Drucken Im Labor für Physikalische Chemie, ETH Zürich, bieten wir eine PhD-Position in der Attosekunden- und Feldphysik an. Das Projekt konzentriert sich auf die hochrangige harmonische Generation (HHG) in Edelgasflüssigkeiten, insbesondere flüssiges Helium. Diese Forschung zielt darauf ab, ein neues Regime der ultraschnellen Elektronendynamik in Kondensstoffen zu erforschen und den Spalt zwischen Gasphase und Flüssigphase HHG zu überbrücken. Die Position bietet die Möglichkeit, an der Spitze der Attosekundenspektroskopie mit modernsten ultraschnellen Lasersystemen und der kryogenen Technologie zu arbeiten. Diese 4-jährige PhD-Position wird durch unseren SNSF-Zuschuss finanziert. Projekthintergrund Hochrangige harmonische Generation ist zu einem Eckpfeiler der Attosekunden-Wissenschaft geworden, der die Beobachtung der Elektronendynamik auf ihren natürlichen Zeitskala ermöglicht. Während HHG in Gasen gut verstanden und in Feststoffen zunehmend erforscht wird, bietet seine Ausdehnung auf Flüssigkeiten faszinierende Möglichkeiten, Elektronenstreu- und Delokalisierungseigenschaften zu untersuchen. Edelgasflüssigkeiten und insbesondere flüssiges Helium bieten eine einzigartige Plattform: Sie kombinieren die Einfachheit atomarer Systeme mit der Dichte von Kondensstoffen. Ihre relativ langen elektronenmittleren freien Wege bieten Zugang zu einem Regime, in dem die Feldphysik unter Zwischenbedingungen zwischen Gasen und molekularen Flüssigkeiten untersucht werden kann. Dieses Projekt zielt darauf ab, HHG-Spektroskopie in edlen Flüssigkeiten zu etablieren, die Rolle der Elektronenstreuung und Kohärenz zu untersuchen und neue Phänomene wie HHG in der suprafluiden Phase des Heliums zu erforschen.
• Entwickeln und betreiben Sie kryogene Flüssigkeitsstrahlsysteme für Edelgasflüssigkeiten
• Implementieren fortgeschrittene ultraschnelle Lasertechniken (z.B. wenige Zyklen, zweifarbige Felder, CEP-Stabilisierung)
• Analysieren Sie experimentelle Daten, um Informationen über die Elektronendynamik zu extrahieren Die Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche ist von Vorteil: ultraschnelle Optik, nichtlineare Optik, HHG/Strong-field Physik, Vakuumtechnik, Spektroskopie oder wissenschaftliche Programmierung (Python, MATLAB). Arbeitsplatz Wir bieten eine vollständig finanzierte PhD-Position an der ETH Zürich, einer der weltweit führenden Universitäten
• Zugang zu hochmodernen ultraschnellen Lasersystemen und experimenteller Infrastruktur

chevron left Übersicht chevron left Übersicht PhD position sur la spectroscopie de génération harmonique de haut niveau dans les liquides à gaz noble 100%, Zurich, tirage à terme fixe Drucken Nous offrons un poste de doctorat en science attoseconde et physique de terrain fort au Laboratoire de chimie physique, ETH Zürich. Le projet met l'accent sur la génération harmonique à haut ordre (HHG) dans les liquides à gaz nobles, en particulier l'hélium liquide. Cette recherche vise à explorer un nouveau régime de dynamique des électrons ultrarapides dans la matière condensée et à combler l'écart entre la phase gazeuse et la phase liquide HHG. La position offre la possibilité de travailler à l'avant-garde de la spectroscopie attoseconde à l'aide de systèmes laser ultrarapides de pointe et de technologie cryogénique. Ce poste de doctorat de 4 ans est financé par notre subvention SNSF. Contexte du projet La génération harmonique de haut niveau est devenue une pierre angulaire de la science de l'attoseconde, permettant l'observation de la dynamique électronique sur leurs échelles de temps naturelles. Bien que le HHG soit bien compris dans les gaz et de plus en plus exploré dans les solides, son extension aux liquides offre des possibilités intrigantes d'étudier les propriétés de diffusion et de délocalisation des électrons. Les liquides à gaz noble, et l'hélium liquide en particulier, constituent une plateforme unique : ils combinent la simplicité des systèmes atomiques avec la densité de la matière condensée. Leurs voies libres moyennes d'électrons relativement longues donnent accès à un régime où la physique des champs forts peut être étudiée dans des conditions intermédiaires entre gaz et liquides moléculaires. Ce projet vise à établir la spectroscopie HHG dans les liquides nobles, à étudier le rôle de la diffusion et de la cohérence des électrons et à explorer de nouveaux phénomènes tels que HHG dans la phase superfluide de l'hélium. Description de travail
• Concevoir et réaliser des expériences sur la génération harmonique à haut niveau dans des cibles en phase liquide et en phase gazeuse
• Développer et exploiter des systèmes cryogéniques à jet liquide pour des liquides à gaz nobles
• Mettre en oeuvre des techniques laser ultrarapides avancées (p. ex. impulsions à peu de cycles, champs bicolores, stabilisation du CEP)
• Analyser des données expérimentales pour extraire des informations sur la dynamique des électrons (échelle de coupure, phase, temps d'émission)
• Contribuer au développement de nouvelles méthodes expérimentales en spectroscopie attoseconde
• Présenter les résultats lors de conférences internationales et publier dans des revues à grand impact Profil
• Maîtrise en physique, chimie physique ou domaine étroitement lié
• Fort intérêt pour la science laser ultrarapide, en physique attoseconde ou en phénomènes à champ fort
• Compétences expérimentales et motivation pour travailler sur des installations de laboratoire complexes
• Capacité de travailler indépendamment et dans le cadre d'une équipe de recherche collaborative
• Bonnes compétences en communication en anglais (parlé et écrit) L'expérience dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants est un avantage : l'optique ultrarapide, l'optique non linéaire, la physique HHG/strong-field, la technologie du vide, la spectroscopie ou la programmation scientifique (Python, MATLAB). Doctoral Student in the Agricultural Economics and Policy Group 100%, Zurich, fixed-term print Drucken The Agricultural Economics and Policy Group led by Robert Finger is looking for a doctoral (PhD) student with a background in agricultural economics for the topic of the economics and policy of climate change mitigation in Swiss agriculture. This 4-year position is funded in the project “ Pathways to a Net-Zero Target for Hard-to-Abate Swiss Emissions ” . Project background The ACHIEVE project brings together 29 member entities and 27 collaboration partners from research, industry and the public sector, who work alongside stakeholders from civil society, politics and industry to develop net-zero strategies for Switzerland and make recommendations for a policy framework. The Agricultural Economics and Policy Group is leading a work package in ACHIEVE on reducing greenhouse gas emissions in Swiss agri-food systems. The doctoral student will focus on the economic, policy, and behavioural aspects of climate change mitigation in Swiss agriculture. You will conduct a choice experiment with farmers, analyse survey and secondary data, test the efficacy and efficiency of different policy instruments and investigate farmers' behaviour and management decisions in the context of climate change mitigation. Your work will combine data collection and data analysis with interaction with farmers and stakeholders, and economic theory. As you will be leading survey and experiment tasks with Swiss farmers, proficiency (C1) in German or French is required. You will collaborate with other doctoral students and postdocs in the project, in our, and other groups. You will be supervised by Robert Finger. Your project and doctorate are scheduled for four years. For further information about the project visit this website . For further information about our group please visit our website . • Analyse survey and secondary data
• Interact with farmers and stakeholders

The HIL building on the Campus Hönggerberg is transformed into a Living Lab. The construction in need of renovation is rebuilt and expanded. Professorships of the Departments of Architecture (D-ARCH) and Construction, Environment and Geomatics (D-BAUG) will explore and plan the renovation of the HIL building in the sense of circular construction in the coming years. The aim is to further develop sustainable design and construction in the existing structure and to demonstrate by way of example a real planning and construction project. For the development of strategies, evaluations based on methodological approaches and the overarching coordination of sustainability planning in the architecture project, we are looking for from 1. July 2026 or by agreement a dedicated and versatile architect, architect or civil engineer, civil engineer with a focus on sustainability. They work in the interdisciplinary team of the Living Lab HIL and are in close cooperation with various professorships. In addition to the development and planning tasks of the Living Lab HIL team, you work with a focus on sustainability topics on the following tasks:

Le implicazioni delle relazioni transnazionali (post)coloniali nello sviluppo dell'Europa, del Nord-America e del Sud globale sono esaminate in questo contesto. Sfondo del progetto - C'è una quantità sempre crescente e la diversità delle osservazioni della Terra raccolte da satelliti, strumenti aeronautici, reti di misura in-situ e dati di modellazione del clima ad alta risoluzione prodotti a C2SM - L'acquisizione di questi dati in modo efficace è essenziale per promuovere la nostra comprensione del sistema terrestre - C2SM in collaborazione con Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) sta estendendo i suoi servizi di dati e sta costruendo un laghetto dati su scala petabyte composto da dati osservazionali e modelli molto diversi - Per affrontare questa sfida, si sta sviluppando un solido framework di gestione dei dati per rendere accessibili e utilizzabili rapidamente i dataset del sistema terrestre per la comunità scientifica -
• Stiamo cercando un responsabile dei dati dei sistemi terrestri per svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione di questo quadro - Questa posizione tecnica si concentra sull'individuazione dei dataset osservativi rilevanti per la ricerca scientifica sulla Terra attraverso le discipline, la cura e la documentazione delle collezioni di dati per garantire qualità e valore scientifico, e la definizione di metadati e standard di accesso per supportare la scoperta e la riproducibilità dei dati - Lavorando a stretto contatto con i ricercatori e gli sviluppatori di C2SM, ETH, CSCS, così come le istituzioni nazionali e internazionali, il candidato di successo sosterrà il funzionamento e l'avanzamento della piattaforma dati, assisterà progetti interdisciplinari che integrano più fonti di dati, e utilizzare risorse di calcolo ad alte prestazioni per gestire e elaborare grandi set di dati ambientali come sono pronti per essere utilizzati per la ricerca Descrizione del lavoro - Earth Systems Data Manager (Petabyte-Scale Infrastructure) 80%-100%, Zurich, fixed-term print Drucken The Center for Climate Systems Modeling (C2SM) at ETH Zurich is a joint, interdisciplinary center linking ETH Zurich with partner institutions. It provides a technology and networking platform to support the development and application of Earth system, weather, and climate modeling, data infrastructure, and impact research. Project background There is an ever-increasing amount and diversity of Earth observations collected from satellites, airborne instruments, in-situ measurement networks, and high-resolution climate modeling data produced at C2SM. Harnessing these data effectively is essential for advancing our understanding of the Earth system. C2SM in collaboration with Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) is extending its data services and is building a petabyte-scale data lake consisting of highly diverse observational and model data. To address this challenge, a robust data management framework is being developed to make rapidly growing Earth-system datasets accessible and usable for the scientific community. We are looking for an Earth Systems Data Manager to play a pivotal role in shaping this framework. This technical position focuses on identifying observational datasets relevant to Earth science research across disciplines, curating and documenting data collections to ensure quality and scientific value, and establishing metadata and access standards to support data discovery and reproducibility. Working closely with researchers and developers from C2SM, ETH, CSCS, as well as national and international institutions, the successful candidate will support operating and advancing the data platform, assist interdisciplinary projects that integrate multiple data sources, and use high-performance computing resources to manage and process large environmental datasets such that they are ready to be used for research. Job description
• Identify Earth system observations that are relevant to interdisciplinary research needs
• Curate data collections by assessing quality, completeness, and scientific value
• Create comprehensive metadata and documentation to support data discovery and use
• Begin developing a platform to provide users with an overview of the available data
• Coordinate with researchers in climate science, environmental monitoring, data science, and related fields
• Collaborate with a dynamic and international team of developers and researchers developers to operate and further advance the data platform
• Support interdisciplinary research projects that require multiple data sources
• Work with high-performance computing platforms for data storage and to provide analysis tools for researchers Profile
• Degree in data science, computer science, Earth or atmospheric sciences, or a related field
• Knowledge of satellite data and remote sensing
• Experience with very large datasets (petabyte-scale), data management and data quality control
• Very good skills with programming languages such as Python/R/Julia, use of scientific data libraries (e.g., xarray, netCDF4, HDF5, Zarr), and workflow automation on HPC systems
• At least 3 years of interdisciplinary work experience (PhD not included)
• Strong communication skills for working across different scientific disciplines Beneficial:
• Experience working in an interdisciplinary environment
• PhD in remote sensing or a related field
• Experience in working with very large atmospheric observational or model data
• Experience in leading projects, ideally within multiple different domains
• Experience with user support, data documentation, FAIR data principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) Workplace Workplace We offer In this role, you will work at the cutting-edge intersection of Earth system modelling, high-performance computing and data-driven science. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec des chercheurs et des développeurs de C2SM, ETH, SCCS, ainsi qu'avec des institutions nationales et internationales, le candidat retenu appuiera le fonctionnement et le développement de la plate-forme de données, aidera les projets interdisciplinaires qui intègrent de multiples sources de données et utilisera des ressources informatiques de haute performance pour gérer et traiter de grands ensembles de données environnementales de sorte qu'ils soient prêts à être utilisés pour la recherche Description du poste - Identifier les observations du système terrestre pertinentes aux besoins de recherche interdisciplinaires - Collecte de données curatives en évaluant la qualité, l'exhaustivité et la valeur scientifique - Créer des métadonnées et une documentation complètes pour appuyer la découverte et l'utilisation des données - Commencer à développer une plate-forme pour fournir aux utilisateurs un aperçu des données disponibles - Coordonner avec les chercheurs en sciences du climat, surveillance de l'environnement, science des données et domaines connexes - Collaborer avec une équipe dynamique et internationale de développeurs et de chercheurs développeurs pour exploiter et faire progresser la plate-forme de données - Soutenir des projets de recherche interdisciplinaires nécessitant plusieurs sources de données - Travailler avec des plateformes informatiques performantes pour le stockage des données et fournir des outils d'analyse aux chercheurs Profil - Diplôme en sciences des données, en informatique, en sciences de la Terre ou de l'atmosphère, ou dans un domaine connexe - Connaissance des données satellitaires et de la télédétection - Expérience avec de très grands ensembles de données (à l'échelle du petabyte), gestion des données et contrôle de la qualité des données - De très bonnes compétences avec des langages de programmation tels que Python/R/Julia, l'utilisation de bibliothèques de données scientifiques (par exemple xarray, netCDF4, HDF5, Zarr) et l'automatisation des flux de travail sur les systèmes HPC - Au moins 3 ans d'expérience de travail interdisciplinaire (PhD non inclus) - Fortes compétences en communication pour travailler dans différentes disciplines scientifiques Bénéfice - Expérience de travail dans un environnement interdisciplinaire - Doctorat en télédétection ou dans un domaine connexe - Expérience de travail avec de très grandes données d'observation atmosphérique ou de modèle - Expérience dans les projets de pointe, idéalement dans plusieurs domaines différents - Expérience avec support utilisateur, documentation de données, principes de données FAIR (fichable, accessible, interopérable, réutilisable) Lieu de travail Lieu de travail
• Cosa offriamo - Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez à l'intersection de pointe de la modélisation du système terrestre, de l'informatique à haute performance et de la science axée sur les données - Vous rejoindrez le Centre de modélisation des systèmes climatiques (C2SM)

## Posizione Vacante ### **Comunicatore/Comunicatrice (50%-60%, Zurigo, contratto temporaneo) NADEL e ETH4D** cercano un/a **Comunicatore/Comunicatrice** a partire da settembre/ottobre 2026 per rafforzare la comunicazione, l’outreach e la presenza online. In questa posizione, sarai responsabile della gestione e dello sviluppo dei canali comunicativi di entrambi gli enti, garantendo messaggi chiari ed engaging. --- ## Descrizione ### **NADEL e ETH4D** NADEL offre vari programmi educativi ed eventi per studenti ETH, professionisti e il pubblico svizzero su cooperazione globale e sviluppo sostenibile. NADEL collabora strettamente con diverse organizzazioni svizzere nel campo dello sviluppo sostenibile globale. ETH4D è un’iniziativa transdisciplinare dell’ETH con oltre 60 gruppi di ricerca provenienti da ingegneria, scienze naturali e sociali. Insieme a partner da industria, politica e società civile, sviluppa innovazioni per affrontare sfide globali e promuove collaborazioni didattiche in ingegneria e scienze naturali con università dell’Africa continentale. Questa posizione rappresenta un’opportunità ideale per professionisti della comunicazione interessati a tematiche di cooperazione internazionale e alla comunicazione di ricerca e insegnamento scientifici a un pubblico più ampio. --- ## Mansioni - Pianificazione, organizzazione e rafforzamento delle attività di comunicazione e outreach di NADEL e ETH4D - Coordinamento, progettazione grafica e correzione di testi per informazioni mediatiche, brief di ricerca e altri materiali comunicativi, ad esempio per l’engagement con donatori o programmi didattici - Sviluppo e implementazione della strategia digitale per i siti web, le newsletter e i social media esistenti, inclusa la produzione di contenuti testuali e visivi - Supporto nella gestione del podcast e delle serie video di NADEL - Pianificazione, organizzazione e gestione di eventi - Supporto nel processo di pubblicazione dei prodotti di NADEL e aiuto a far crescere la rete di NADEL --- ##
• Requisiti - Laurea in comunicazione, giornalismo, studi mediatici, pubbliche relazioni o campo correlato - Almeno 2 anni di esperienza lavorativa in comunicazione o pubbliche relazioni - Esperienza dimostrabile nella creazione di contenuti, comunicazione digitale e social media (LinkedIn, Instagram) - Forte capacità di scrittura e editing in inglese (conoscenza del tedesco e del francese è un plus) - Prova di capacità di gestire diverse attività con scadenze stringenti - Personalità proattiva, organizzata e capace di lavorare in modo autonomo - Competenze in progettazione grafica, creazione di contenuti video/visivi (un plus) - Conoscenza del settore della cooperazione internazionale (un plus) - Esperienza lavorativa in ambiente accademico (un plus) --- ##
• Cosa offriamo - Ambiente di lavoro dinamico, internazionale e interdisciplinare - Opportunità di contribuire a lavori ad alto impatto all’intersezione tra ricerca, educazione e sviluppo globale - **Chevron_right** Lavoro, insegnamento e ricerca all’ETH Zurigo - Valutiamo la diversità e la sostenibilità - In linea con i nostri valori, l’ETH Zurigo incoraggia una cultura inclusiva. Promuoviamo l’uguaglianza di opportunità, valorizziamo la diversità e coltiviamo un ambiente di lavoro e di apprendimento in cui i diritti e la dignità di tutti i nostri dipendenti e studenti siano rispettati. Visita il nostro sito sulle pari opportunità e diversità per scoprire come garantiamo un ambiente aperto e giusto che permetta a tutti di crescere e fiorire. - La sostenibilità è un valore fondamentale per noi: lavoriamo costantemente per raggiungere una futura neutralità climatica. --- **Curioso? Lo siamo anche noi.** Ci aspettiamo di ricevere la tua candidatura online con i seguenti documenti in un unico file PDF entro il 20 giugno 2026: - CV (massimo 2 pagine) - Un breve video (massimo 3 minuti) in cui ti spieghi: 1. cosa ti motiva a candidarti, 2. perché ritieni di essere una buona scelta per questa posizione. Non aspettatevi un video professionale. Una registrazione con il vostro smartphone è sufficiente. Perfettamente accettabile è anche l’upload su una piattaforma di tua scelta (Dropbox, YouTube, Vimeo, Google).
descriptionByLocale.en:
Communication Specialist 50%-60%, Zurich, fixed-term print Drucken We are seeking a creative Communication Specialist starting from September/October 2026 to help us intensify our communication, outreach and online presence. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and further developing the communication channels of NADEL and ETH4D, ensuring clear and engaging messaging. About NADEL and ETH4D NADEL offers various educational programs and events for ETH students, professionals, and the Swiss public on global cooperation and sustainable development. NADEL works closely with various Swiss organisations within the field of global sustainable development. ETH4D is an ETH-wide initiative of over 60 research groups from engineering, natural sciences to social sciences, which develop innovations that address global challenges and foster teaching collaborations in engineering and natural sciences with universities on the African continent. This position is a great opportunity for communications professionals who are interested in global development issues and communication of scientific research and teaching to a wider audience. Job description You will be responsible for the overall planning, organization, and strengthening of the communication and outreach activities. Key responsibilities include:
• Coordination, layout design, and copy-editing of media information, research briefs, reports and further communications material
• Communicating teaching programs and engaging with donors
• Implementing and further developing the digital strategy of existing websites, newsletters, and social media, including producing text and visual content
• Support with NADEL's podcast, video series, and annual panel
• Planning, organizing and managing events
• Helping to grow our network The position is limited to a duration of 2 years. Profile
• Degree in communication, journalism, media studies, public relations or a related field
• At least 2 years of work experience in communications or public relations
• Proven experience in content creation, digital communication and social media (LinkedIn, Instagram)
• Strong writing and editing skills in English (German and French is a plus)
• Proven ability to handle a number of different tasks with tight deadlines
• Proactive, organized, and able to work independently
• Skills in graphic design, video/visual content creation is a plus
• Familiarity with the international cooperation sector is a plus
• Work experience in academic environment is a plus Workplace Workplace We offer
• A dynamic, international and interdisciplinary working environment
• The opportunity to contribute to impactful work at the interphase of research, education and global development chevron_right Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich We value diversity and sustainability In line with our values , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future . Curious? So are we. We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents in one PDF file by 20th of June 2026:
• CV (max. 2-3 pages)
• A short video (max. 3 minutes) of yourself telling us: (1) what motivates you to apply, and (2) why you think you're a great fit for this role. We do not expect a professionally produced video. A recording with your smartphone is perfectly sufficient. Please upload the video to a platform of your choice (Dropbox, YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive, etc.) and include the corresponding URL link in your CV.
• 1-2 work samples
• Degree certificates
• Letters of recomme

Gestione del team ETH Diversity (m/f/d) 80%, Zurigo, stampa permanente ETH Diversity fa parte della Divisione Diversità e Cooperazione e si trova nella Divisione Gestione della Scuola del Vice Presidente dello Sviluppo del Personale e Leadership (VPPL). Nell'ambito di VPPL, ci aspettiamo per una cultura e una leadership inclusiva, incontriamo i nostri simili esseri umani con un'uguaglianza di marcia, ci prendiamo la responsabilità, il pensiero e il lavoro in una rete e abbiamo una passione per gli approcci innovativi – con coraggio e facilità. La nostra visione: Insieme diamo potere alle persone di sviluppare il potenziale di se stessi e di altri. Ecco una breve intervista video con la nostra Vice Presidente Julia Dannath. Come Team Leader ETH Diversity, sei responsabile dello sviluppo strategico e operativo della diversità, dell'uguaglianza e dell'inclusione nell'ETH di Zurigo. Nel tuo ruolo, lavori all'interfaccia di gestione universitaria, unità organizzative e stakeholder esterni. Essi assicurano che gli aspetti del DEI siano sistematicamente integrati nelle strutture, nei processi e nella cultura organizzativa dell'ETE e sviluppino strategie e programmi coerenti e universitari. Essi comprendono la diversità, l'uguaglianza e l'inclusione come compito strategico di taglio trasversale dello sviluppo universitario responsabile e come componente centrale di eccellenza, innovazione e pari opportunità. Descrizione del lavoro
• Si guida il team della diversità in termini di competenze e personale e posizionare l'argomento come parte integrante dello sviluppo istituzionale dell'università. Essi consigliano i nostri dipartimenti e enti centrali su questioni strategiche e concettuali e sono responsabili per lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di formati di sensibilizzazione, formazione e informazione per diversi gruppi target.
• Insieme al vostro team, svilupperete misure sostenibili come parte dello sviluppo universitario responsabile e di una componente centrale di eccellenza, innovazione e pari opportunità.

• Osservano e analizzano gli sviluppi della politica sociale, legale e universitaria e li traducono in concetti di azione strategicamente rilevanti per l'ETH Zurigo.
• Laurea in scienze sociali, sviluppo organizzativo, studi di genere o una disciplina correlata - o esperienza professionale equivalente nell'area del DEI
• Forte competenza nello sviluppo, nel controllo strategico e nella valutazione dei programmi del DEI
• Know-how nella concezione e nell'attuazione di sistemi di sensibilizzazione, formazione e consulenza organizzativi
• Competenze di consulenza e di moderazione in relazione ai processi di sviluppo organizzativo e culturale Si può aspettare un'area di lavoro estremamente emozionante in cui è possibile sviluppare la vostra esperienza
descriptionByLocale.en:
Team management ETH Diversity (m/f/d) 80%, Zurich, permanent print printing ETH Diversity is part of the Division of Diversity and Cooperation and is located in the School Management Division of the Vice President of Personnel Development and Leadership (VPPL). As part of VPPL, we stand for an inclusive culture and leadership, meet our fellow human beings on an equal footing, enjoy taking responsibility, thinking and working in a network and have a passion for innovative approaches – with courage and ease. Our vision: Together we empower people to develop the potential of themselves and others. Here is a short video interview with our Vice President Julia Dannath. As Team Leader ETH Diversity, you are responsible for the strategic and operational development of diversity, equality and inclusion at ETH Zurich. In your role, you work at the interface of university management, organizational units and external stakeholders. They ensure that DEI aspects are systematically integrated into the structures, processes and organizational culture of the ETH and develop coherent, university-wide strategies and programs. They understand diversity, equality and inclusion as a strategic cross-cutting task of responsible university development and as a central component of excellence, innovation and equal opportunities. Job description
• You lead the diversity team in terms of expertise and personnel and position the topic as an integral part of the university’s institutional development. They advise our departments and central bodies on strategic and conceptual issues and are responsible for the further development and implementation of awareness-raising, training and information formats for different target groups.
• Together with your team, you will develop sustainable measures as part of responsible university development and a central component of excellence, innovation and equal opportunities.
• They represent ETH Diversity in relevant internal and external committees and networks and contribute to the national and international positioning of ETH Zurich in the DEI context.
• They observe and analyze societal, legal and university policy developments and translate them into strategically relevant action concepts for ETH Zurich. Profile
• University degree in social sciences, organizational development, gender studies or a related discipline - or equivalent professional experience in the DEI area
• Strong expertise in the development, strategic control and evaluation of DEI programmes
• Know-how in the conception and implementation of organization-wide awareness-raising, training and consulting formats
• Consulting and moderation competence in connection with organizational and cultural development processes
• Leadership competence with integrative, cooperative leadership style
• In-depth knowledge of the legal and regulatory framework in the areas of equality, protection against discrimination and codes of conduct in complex systems
• Strong strategic, analytical and communicative skills with an overall institutional perspective
• Networking in the DEI context as well as interest in the further development of national and international networking
• Negotiation-proof German and English skills We offer
• Your profession with effect: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive changes in society
• You can expect an extremely exciting area of work in which you can develop your expertise

• Vous dirigez l'équipe de la diversité en termes d'expertise et de personnel et placez le sujet comme partie intégrante du développement institutionnel de l'université. • Avec votre équipe, vous développerez des mesures durables dans le cadre d'un développement universitaire responsable et d'une composante centrale de l'excellence, de l'innovation et de l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.it:
PhD Researcher - tenoexo 100%, Singapore, fixed-term Drucken The Singapore-ETH Centre was established in 2010 by ETH Zurich - The Swiss Federal Institute of Technology and Singapore’s National Research Foundation (NRF), as part of the NRF’s CREATE campus. As ETH Zurich's only research centre outside of Switzerland, the centre has strengthened the research capacity of ETH Zurich to develop sustainable solutions to global challenges in Switzerland, Singapore and the surrounding regions. Set in Asia, in a rapidly urbanising region, the Singapore-ETH Centre aims to provide practical solutions to some of the most pressing challenges on urban sustainability, resilience and health through its programmes: Future Cities Lab Global (FCL Global) and Future Health Technologies (FHT) . The centre serves as an intellectual hub for research, bringing together principal investigators and researchers from diverse disciplines and backgrounds. To promote the exchange of ideas and expertise, our researchers actively collaborate with universities and research institutes and engage with industry and government agencies to translate knowledge to practical solutions to real-world problems. Project background Stroke remains a leading cause of disability worldwide. While improved early stroke response has reduced mortality, it has also led to a growing population of stroke survivors, increasing the demand for long-term rehabilitation and placing significant clinical and economic burden on healthcare systems. The current neurorehabilitation model relies heavily on resource-intensive, therapist-led care to meet the growing demand, underscoring the need for scalable, cost-effective solutions that extend into home settings. To address this gap the first phase of the Future Health Technologies Programme (FHT1) at the Singapore-ETH Centre (SEC) (https://fht.ethz.ch) developed and piloted innovative upper limb rehabilitation technologies and evaluated them in a clinical context, both in the hospital and at the home of post-stroke subjects. Building on this progress, FHT2 seeks to scale up these technologies and conduct more extensive clinical evaluation to promote integration of technology-based clinic-to-home rehabilitation into Singapore’s healthcare system. Specifically, one of our projects focuses on the technical development and clinical validation of a soft robotic hand orthosis to enhance upper limb rehabilitation sessions in the clinic and allow for additional task-oriented training at home. The project will build on the RELab tenoexo technology, a soft exoskeleton that was developed at ETH Zurich and refined during FHT1. As main features, RELab tenoexo can support grasping, is fully tailorable to the hand of the user, is fully wearable and weighs less than 300g. A proof-of-concept trial demonstrated preliminary feasibility and safety of using RELab tenoexo in chronic stroke. Within this PhD project, the objective will be to further develop and evaluate RELab tenoexo and demonstrate that a soft hand exoskeleton can be a cost-efficient way to increase therapy dose at home and improve upper limb function of post-stroke subjects. To achieve this goal, we will (i) improve and optimize several key design features of RELab tenoexo,(ii) combine RELab tenoexo with behavioural interventions delivered by a motivational AI chatbot (developed by another PhD student) to enhance motivation to engage in therapy at home, and (iii) evaluate long-term adherence to use at home, functional improvements, movement quality metrics, as well as required resources/costs in the context of a proof of value clinical trial.

Project background Stroke remains a leading cause of disability worldwide. While improved early stroke response has reduced mortality, it has also led to a growing population of stroke survivors, increasing the demand for long-term rehabilitation and placing significant clinical and economic burden on healthcare systems. However, adherence to home rehabilitation without therapist supervision and support can be challenging, ultimately affecting therapy dose. In this project, we will complement the exoskeleton with an AI-based digital health intervention, specifically an LLM-based conversational agent that will deliver support via a companion mobile app. The app will serve as both the user interface for daily interaction and support and a digital platform for data collection, remote monitoring, and telerehabilitation. Within this PhD project, the objective will be to (i) derive the key requirements for the design of the digital platform and the LLM-based conversational agent (together with the input from end-users and building on pre-existing prototypes); (ii) iteratively develop the app and key interactive features (e.g., AI-based conversational agent, motivational interviewing, etc.) including their validation; (iii) interface the app with the soft hand exoskeleton technology (developed by another PhD student) (data transfer, data interpretation, feedback provision); and (iv) evaluate its impact on long-term adherence to a technology-supported rehabilitation intervention at home in the context of a 6-week proof of value clinical trial.

Luglio 2026 o d'intesa un assistente studente per la posizione di sviluppatore web:in e amministratore di sistema:in (m/w/d) per il supporto e lo sviluppo dei nostri progetti IT. descriptionByLocale.en:
Web Developer:in und System-Administrator:in als Studentische Hilfskraft (m/w/d) 10%, Zurich, limited print Print The Library of the Department of Computer Science is looking for 1. July 2026 or by agreement a student assistant for the position as a web developer:in and system administrator:in (m/w/d) for the support and development of our IT projects. The employment is part-time and in the hourly wage. The use is as required, on average 12 hours per month. Description - As a web developer:in you support the library-internal web application and the website - You keep the application on the state of the art, fix bugs, and implement new features in cooperation with the library management - You are available to the team as contact person:in case of technical problems - You work closely with the Informatics Support Group of the Department of Informatics, which provide the Kubernetes platform, network, storage and other services for you, yet much is your responsibility (backups etc.) - As a system administrator:in you are responsible for the operation of infrastructure and applications - You know the setup of applications and infrastructure (data backup, databases, certificates, etc.) and can make adjustments
• Profile - You are preferably at the beginning of your studies - You have already worked with git - You are familiar with Linux operating system - You have experience in operating your own server - You are interested in expanding your knowledge in web development and DevOps as well as the Kubernetes platform - You like to take responsibility and can work independently Ideally - Experience with Python 3 (optional TypeScript) - Experience with web projects (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), e.g. with Django - Experience with REST APIs - Experience with databases and SQL (e.g. MySQL, MariaDB, Postgres) - Experience with containerization and docker - Experience with Kubernetes or "Docker Swarm" systems
• Cosa offriamo -
• We offer a challenging, interesting and varied activity in a young team - Your working time and workload can be flexibly divided and adapted to the current study load Contatto - We look forward to your online application with the following documents: - Application letter - CV - For more information about the Computer Science Library, please visit our website . - Mrs Selina O'Kerwin, Tel. +41 44 632 72 07 or e-mail selina.okerwin@inf.ethz.ch (no application documents).

Consulente senior (m/w/d) 80%, Basilea, illimitato stampa Stampa Il Dipartimento dei Biosistemi (D-BSSE) dell'ETH di Zurigo a Basilea impiega oltre 400 dipendenti nell'insegnamento e nella ricerca. La nostra unità di organizzazione Facility Services for Science and Teaching (FaST) supporta la ricerca con aree di sterilizzazione centralizzate e lavastoviglie, nonché il supporto tecnico per attrezzature e infrastrutture scientifiche. Scopri di più su di noi sul nostro sito web . Sfondo del progetto Il team Facility Services for Science and Teaching (FaST) di ETH Zurich D-BSSE supporta la ricerca attraverso aree di sterilizzazione e lavaggio dei piatti centrali e supporto tecnico per le infrastrutture di laboratorio. In questa posizione, si contribuisce a garantire un funzionamento regolare dei nostri laboratori moderni eseguendo la sterilizzazione, la pulizia e la manutenzione di dispositivi scientifici professionalmente. Il loro lavoro contribuisce quindi direttamente alla ricerca nel sistema e nella biologia sintetica del sito di Basilea. Designazione Nel vostro ruolo, il nostro team di infrastrutture vi supporta in un ambiente moderno e dinamico che si concentra sul sistema e sulla biologia sintetica. I vostri compiti includono:
• Sterilizzazione e pulizia: lavatrice e lavaggio professionale e sterilizzazione di piatti di laboratorio, inattivazione di campioni biologici e manipolazione di rifiuti biologici (fino al livello di sicurezza 2) nella sterilizzazione centrale.
• Manutenzione e manutenzione: manutenzione, manutenzione, manutenzione, manutenzione e coordinamento delle attrezzature scientifiche del reparto.
• Organizzazione: distribuzione postale, cooperazione nella gestione del parcheggio, ordine e pulizia nelle aree di lavoro del team FaST.
• Organizzazione di emergenza: In caso di interesse, partecipazione all'organizzazione di emergenza del dipartimento Lavorano a stretto contatto con il team FaST e si assumono la responsabilità di una esecuzione qualitativamente corretta, tempestiva e mirata di tutti i compiti assegnati. Profilo
• Esperienza pratica nella sterilizzazione, nella pulizia del laboratorio e nella gestione dei rifiuti o nella volontà di imparare questo.
• conoscenza dei rifiuti chimici e dei campioni biologici

Senior Consultant (m/w/d) 80%, Basel, unlimited print Print The Department of Biosystems (D-BSSE) at ETH Zurich in Basel employs more than 400 employees in teaching and research. Our Facility Services for Science and Teaching (FaST) organization unit supports research with centralized sterilization and dishwashing areas as well as technical support for scientific equipment and infrastructure. Find out more about us on our website . Project background The Facility Services for Science and Teaching (FaST) team at ETH Zurich's D-BSSE supports research through central sterilization and dishwashing areas as well as technical support for laboratory infrastructure. In this position, you contribute to ensuring a smooth operation of our modern laboratories by performing sterilization, cleaning and maintenance of scientific devices professionally. Their work thus makes a direct contribution to research in system and synthetic biology at the Basel site. Description In your role, our infrastructure team supports you in a modern and dynamic environment focusing on system and synthetic biology. Your tasks include:
• Sterilization and cleaning: machine and professional washing and sterilization of laboratory dishes, inactivating biological samples and handling of biological waste (up to safety level 2) in central sterilization.
• Maintenance and maintenance: maintenance, maintenance, maintenance, maintenance and coordination of scientific equipment at the department.
• Organization: Postal distribution, cooperation in car park management, order and cleanliness in work areas of the FaST team.
• Emergency organisation: In case of interest, participation in the emergency organisation of the department They work closely with the FaST team and bear the responsibility for a qualitatively correct, timely and targeted execution of all assigned tasks. Profile
• Practical experience in sterilization, laboratory cleaning and waste management or the willingness to learn this.
• knowledge of chemical waste and biological samples
• German and English in word and writing
• Initiative, communication strength, team skills and customer orientation, social competence
• Physical resilience and agility,
• Basic training in safety
• Basic technical or craft training Place of employment Place of employment We offer
• A varied activity in a dynamic, active team
• A workplace with good access to public transport
• Various training opportunities at ETH Zurich
• Attractive benefits, e.g. half-tax and pension benefits at PUBLICA

Wang). Il candidato di successo sarà ospitato dall'Istituto di Ingegneria Ambientale, ETH Zürich e matricolato in ETH Zürich. La ricerca è legata allo sviluppo di tecniche sperimentali e di modellazione per identificare le fonti di emissione, simulare il trasporto aereo, analizzare i dati genomici e studiare il destino e l'impatto del bioaerosol. Bioaerosol, compresi i batteri, i virus, i funghi e i frammenti di questi organismi pongono rischi per l'uomo. PhD position – Source tracking for bioaerosol 100%, Zurich, fixed-term print Drucken Applications are invited for a PhD position in the Air Quality and Particle Technology group (Prof. Dr. J. Wang). The successful candidate will be hosted by the Institute of Environmental Engineering, ETH Zürich and matriculate in ETH Zürich. The research is related to development of experimental and modeling techniques to identify emission sources, simulate the airborne transport, analyze the genomics data, and study the fate and impact of bioaerosol. Bioaerosol, including airborne bacteria, viruses, fungi, and fragments of these organisms pose risks to human. Emerging hazardous components such as antibiotic resistance genes and metal resistance genes highlight the evolving risks due to bioaerosols. Metagenomics, bioinformatics, air quality simulation models, and source tracking tools are expected to contribute to the research goals. Our group is engaged in development of technologies for bioaerosol sampling and detection, and air quality models with high spatiotemporal resolution, providing a solid platform for the PhD candidate. Job description The student will be involved in tasks such as:
• To collect air samples
• To apply microbiological methods such as qPCR and sequencing to identify and quantity bioaerosols
• To employ data analysis and bioinformatics to extract bioaerosol characteristics
• To apply source tracking tools to identify the sources and quantify the contributions
• To employ air quality models to investigate the transport and fate of bioaerosol and assess the impact We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities. That's what counts - not age, gender, origin, religion, sexual orientation, etc. Profile

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione PhD Posizione: Modellazione geologica 3D dei Penninici orientali 100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato stampa Druppo Il gruppo di Geologia strutturale e Tettonica si concentra sulle zone in rapido deformazione che definiscono i confini della placca tettonica della Terra e generano molti dei geohazard del pianeta. Abbiamo una nuova posizione di dottorato aperta sulla modellazione geologica 3D dei Penninici orientali nelle Alpi svizzere. Sfondo del progetto La pila di nappe del Penninic orientale delle Alpi svizzere conserva un complesso record di sottoduzione, accrezione, emplacement nappe, metamorfismo e riesumazione. I suoi principali confini tettonici forniscono un eccezionale laboratorio naturale per ricostruire l'architettura tridimensionale delle Alpi e per testare come la geometria ereditata, la litologia e la storia della deformazione influenzano le strutture a scala crustale. Nell'ambito del progetto swisstopo swissAlps3D, questo progetto PhD utilizzerà la modellazione geologica 3D come strumento di base per ricostruire la struttura subsuperficiale dei Penninici orientali in Svizzera. Nel corso di quattro anni, il candidato costruirà un modello geologico di alta qualità 3D integrando mappe geologiche, dati strutturali, sezioni trasversali, informazioni tunnel e borehole, vincoli geofisici e dataset metamorfici e termocronologici pubblicati. Il progetto coinvolgerà la collaborazione con i vicini sforzi di modellazione, così come i lavori mirati basati sul campo su determinati confini tettonici all'interno dell'area del modello. Questi sforzi mirano a collegare l'architettura 3D su scala regionale con variazioni di litologia, tessuti di deformazione, storia metamorfica e caratteristiche correlate ai fluidi lungo le principali interfacce crostali. Nelle fasi successive del progetto, il candidato utilizzerà il modello 3D attribuito per sviluppare una rappresentazione orientata al processo di un antico sistema di subduzione-interfaccia ed esplorare come la sua geometria e l'eterogeneità interna possono avere influenzato segmentazione, localizzazione dei ceppi e comportamento dello slip. Il progetto, finanziato da swisstopo , sarà ospitato nel Gruppo di Geologia e Tettoniche strutturali dell'ETH di Zurigo sotto la supervisione del Prof. Whitney Behr, in collaborazione con swisstopo e il Dr. Lukas Nibourel nel gruppo Georesources Switzerland all'ETH di Zurigo. Descrizione del lavoro - Compili e armonizzare i dati geologici regionali, comprese le mappe, le sezioni trasversali, le misurazioni strutturali, i dati dei tunnel e dei borehole, e i vincoli pubblicati - Costruire un modello geologico 3D in tre parti dello stack Penninic nappe orientale, con chiara documentazione di ipotesi e incertezze - Sviluppare uno schema strutturale coerente e una leggenda unitaria in coordinamento con gli sforzi di modellazione svizzera e vicina - Condurre attività di campo mirate per risolvere incertezze geometriche chiave e raccogliere osservazioni strutturali - Utilizzare il modello 3D per indagare l'architettura, la continuità e il significato tettonico dei principali confini crociati - Preparare la documentazione del modello, le relazioni, i manoscritti e le presentazioni delle conferenze Profilo - MSc in Scienze della Terra/Geologia o un campo correlato - Forte interesse per la geologia del campo, geologia strutturale, tettonica e/o modellazione geologica 3-D - Esperienza con mappatura geologica, GIS, costruzione a sezione trasversale, o software di modellazione 3D è un vantaggio - Volontà di condurre il lavoro sul terreno alpino - Solido inglese competenze; tedesco è utile ma non richiesto - Collaborativo, organizzato, indipendente e attento con set di dati complessi e incertezza Luogo di lavoro Luogo di lavoro Cosa? - Un ambiente amichevole, dinamico e interdisciplinare nel Gruppo di Geologia e Tettoniche strutturali (diretto dal Prof. Whitney Behr) - Accesso a una vasta gamma di strutture sperimentali e analitiche presso ETH Zentrum e ScopeM (Hönggerberg) - Competitività salariale e benefici (cfr. qui ); la posizione del dottorato è finanziata per quattro anni chevron right Lavoro, insegnamento e ricerca presso l'ETH di Zurigo Apprezziamo la diversità e la sostenibilità In linea con i nostri valori, ETH Zurich incoraggia una cultura inclusiva. PhD Position: 3-D Geological Modelling of the Eastern Penninics 100%, Zurich, fixed-term print Drucken The Structural Geology and Tectonics group focuses on the rapidly deforming zones that define Earth’s tectonic plate boundaries and generate many of the planet’s geohazards. We have a new PhD position open on 3D geologic modeling of the eastern Penninics in the Swiss Alps. Project background The eastern Penninic nappe stack of the Swiss Alps preserves a complex record of subduction, accretion, nappe emplacement, metamorphism, and exhumation. Its major tectonic boundaries provide an exceptional natural laboratory for reconstructing the three-dimensional architecture of the Alps and for testing how inherited geometry, lithology, and deformation history influence crustal-scale structures. As part of the swisstopo swissAlps3D project, this PhD project will use 3-D geological modelling as a core tool to reconstruct the subsurface structure of the eastern Penninics in Switzerland. Over four years, the candidate will build a high-quality, 3-D geological model by integrating geological maps, structural data, cross-sections, tunnel and borehole information, geophysical constraints, and published metamorphic and thermochronological datasets. The project will involve collaboration with neighbouring modelling efforts, as well as targeted field-based work on selected tectonic boundaries within the model area. These efforts aim to link regional-scale 3-D architecture with variations in lithology, deformation fabrics, metamorphic history, and fluid-related features along major crustal interfaces. In the later stages of the project, the candidate will use the attributed 3-D model to develop a process-oriented representation of an ancient subduction-interface system and explore how its geometry and internal heterogeneity may have influenced segmentation, strain localization, and slip behaviour. The project, funded by swisstopo , will be hosted in the Structural Geology & Tectonics Group at ETH Zurich under the supervision of Prof. Whitney Behr, in collaboration with swisstopo and Dr. Lukas Nibourel in the Georesources Switzerland Group at ETH Zurich. Job description
• Compile and harmonise regional geological datasets, including maps, cross-sections, structural measurements, tunnel and borehole data,and published constraints
• Build a three-part 3-D geological model of the eastern Penninic nappe stack, with clear documentation of assumptions and uncertainties
• Develop a consistent structural scheme and unit legend in coordination with swisstopo and neighbouring modelling efforts
• Conduct targeted fieldwork to resolve key geometric uncertainties and collect structural observations
• Use the 3-D model to investigate the architecture, continuity, and tectonic significance of major crustal boundaries
• Prepare model documentation, reports, manuscripts, and conference presentations Profile
• MSc in Earth Sciences/Geology or a related field
• Strong interest in field geology, structural geology, tectonics, and/or 3-D geological modelling
• Experience with geological mapping, GIS, cross-section construction, or 3-D modelling software is an advantage
• Willingness to conduct fieldwork in Alpine terrain
• Solid English skills; German is helpful but not required
• Collaborative, organized, independent, and careful with complex datasets and uncertainty Workplace Workplace We offer
• A friendly, dynamic, and interdisciplinary environment in the Structural Geology & Tectonics Group (led by Prof. Whitney Behr)
• Access to a wide range of experimental and analytical facilities at ETH Zentrum and ScopeM (Hönggerberg)
